title: A Rubric-Supervised Critic from Sparse Real-World Outcomes
summary: Academic benchmarks for coding agents tend to reward autonomous task completion, measured by verifiable rewards such as unit-test success. In contrast, real-world coding agents operate with humans in the loop, where success signals are typically noisy, delayed, and sparse. How can we bridge this gap? In this paper, we propose a process to learn a "critic" model from sparse and noisy interaction data, which can then be used both as a reward model for either RL-based training or inference-time scaling. Specifically, we introduce Critic Rubrics, a rubric-based supervision framework with 24 behavioral features that can be derived from human-agent interaction traces alone. Using a semi-supervised objective, we can then jointly predict these rubrics and sparse human feedback (when present). In experiments, we demonstrate that, despite being trained primarily from trace-observable rubrics and sparse real-world outcome proxies, these critics improve best-of-N reranking on SWE-bench (Best@8 +15.9 over Random@8 over the rerankable subset of trajectories), enable early stopping (+17.7 with 83% fewer attempts), and support training-time data curation via critic-selected trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Critic Rubrics」框架：把真实人机协作中的多轮轨迹切分为「段（segment）」，用 24 个可从轨迹观测的行为特征作为稠密过程监督，与稀疏的真实结果代理（PR 合并、代码存活率）一起半监督训练一个 4B 的 critic 模型。该 critic 可用于推理时的 Best-of-K 重排序（SWE-bench Best@8 相比随机 +15.9）、早停（+17.7 且平均尝试次数仅 1.35，节省 83% 计算）以及训练时的数据筛选（critic 选样 SFT 后 47.8% vs 随机 46.2%）。
AI.motivation: 学术基准（如 SWE-bench）用单元测试这类可验证奖励衡量代码 agent 的自主任务完成能力，但真实部署中 agent 与人协作，成功信号稀疏（仅 4% 段有 code survival 标签、6% 有 PR merge 标签）、延迟、噪声大，且存在信用分配问题：终端奖励只是某个动作是否正确的噪声近似。此外，benchmark 训练的 critic 在真实数据上接近随机（AUC 0.45–0.48），甚至在 SWE-bench 上的下游选择反而低于随机 12.3 个点。核心问题是如何利用稀疏、含噪的真实交互数据训练出可泛化的 critic。
AI.method: 1）数据建模：将 benchmark 任务与真实多轮对话统一表示为 segment 序列（从用户消息到 agent 的 finish 动作），构建 PR→commit→segment 三层归因结构以做信用分配；定义两个结果代理：PR merge（会话级二值）与 code survival（段级连续比例，定义为该段提交中存活于最终合并 diff 的行数占比）；commit 归属以精度优先，歧义则不标注。2）Critic Rubrics：通过人机协同迭代构建 24 个段级行为特征（13 个 agent 行为问题 + 8 个用户后续反馈模式 + 2 个基础设施问题 + 用户情感分类），由 o3 依据类型化 schema/工具定义批量标注，标注器不可见任何结果标签以避免泄漏；schema 随是否有用户后续回复自适应（无后续时用精简 rubric，并附带 task_type、dev_cluster、user_goal_summary 等通用字段）。3）半监督 critic：以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 初始化并加多任务预测头，联合预测 rubric 特征与成功概率；比较 Success-Only 与 Success+Rubrics 两种目标，以及 survival 的 BCE-floor / BCE-round / MSE 三种变体；输入为 64K 上下文左截断的段轨迹。4）统计验证：对每个二元 rubric 计算 Δ=P(success|detected)−P(success|¬detected)，用 Fisher 精确检验 + Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 校正，跨数据集用 harmonic mean p 值做元分析。
AI.result: 真实数据监督是必需的：仅用 SWE-Gym 训练的 critic 在真实数据上 AUC 仅 0.45–0.48，且 SWE-bench Best@8 仅 45.6%（低于随机 57.9%）。code survival 比 PR merge 提供更细粒度、可归因的监督（真实数据 AUC 0.69 vs 0.58），尽管其标签更稀疏。Rubric 监督带来跨 backbone 鲁棒性：Success-Only 在 Sonnet 4.5 上 Δ@4=+7.0 却在 Opus 4.5 上 −8.1，Success+Rubrics(BCE-floor) 在两者均正（+3.9 / +2.6），Combined 上 Best@8 达 73.8%（较随机 +15.9，较 Success-Only +10.2），MRR 0.83；直接 survival 回归（MSE）排序差，低于随机。早停以 τ=0.5 时 Success+Rubrics(BCE-floor) 较随机 +17.7，平均仅 1.35 次尝试（83% 计算节省）。训练时用 critic 选样做 SFT：47.8%（基座 46.6%，随机 46.2%），而用真实 survival=1 过滤达 50.4%，说明仍有提升空间。critic 复现 LLM 标注的平均 AUC 为 0.78（最可预测特征 0.81）；4B critic 推理约 1.1s/段，比 o3 标注器快约 16×。Rubric 效应分析显示：benchmark 上 incomplete_implementation、insufficient_testing、insufficient_debugging 等使成功率下降 15–21 个百分点（q<0.001），而真实数据效应更弱更噪，且依赖代理类型（如 removal_or_reversion_request 对 survival 的 Δ=−0.13）。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界监督不可替代；code survival 是比 PR merge 更精细、更可归因的过程信号；rubric 监督让 critic 学到与 backbone 无关的行为级失败模式，从而可作为跨模型共享的打分函数，支撑推理时扩展（Best-of-K 与早停）与训练时数据筛选。局限包括：真实结果代理本身有噪声、非 agent 因素（评审者可用性、人工后续编辑）会引入混淆；过度依赖 critic 分数可能导致 reward hacking 或遗漏 rubric 未覆盖的失败模式；单一部署场景训练的 critic 未必迁移到其他用户群或产品形态。缓解措施为公开 rubric 与模型、建议人在环验证、监控分数分布漂移。作者开源了模型（openhands-critic-4b-v1.0）、rubric 定义与代码。

title: Biased Generalization in Diffusion Models
summary: Generalization in generative modeling is defined as the ability to learn an underlying distribution from a finite dataset and produce novel samples, with evaluation largely driven by held-out performance and perceived sample quality. In practice, training is often stopped at the minimum of the test loss, taken as an operational indicator of generalization. We challenge this viewpoint by identifying a phase of biased generalization during training, in which the model continues to decrease the test loss while favoring samples with anomalously high proximity to training data. By training the same network on two disjoint datasets and comparing the mutual distances of generated samples and their similarity to training data, we introduce a quantitative measure of bias and demonstrate its presence on real images. We then study the mechanism of bias, using a controlled hierarchical data model where access to exact scores and ground-truth statistics allows us to precisely characterize its onset. We attribute this phenomenon to the sequential nature of feature learning in deep networks, where coarse structure is learned early in a data-independent manner, while finer features are resolved later in a way that increasingly depends on individual training samples. Our results show that early stopping at the test loss minimum, while optimal under standard generalization criteria, may be insufficient for privacy-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文指出扩散模型中的“泛化”与“记忆”并非对立轴，而是正交的两条轴：在训练过程中存在一个“偏置泛化”（biased generalization）阶段，测试损失仍在下降，但生成样本已系统性地向各自训练数据靠拢。这表明在测试损失最小处早停虽符合标准泛化判据，却不足以作为隐私/版权保护手段。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的训练实践通常在测试损失（DSM loss）最小处早停，并将其视为泛化与隐私安全的操作指标。但 Carlini 等人指出，即便被报告为未过拟合的模型（如 Imagen）也会近乎精确复现训练样本，说明“泛化 vs. 记忆”的二分法过于粗糙：分布层面的损失指标无法排除生成向训练样本的系统性偏置。此外，DSM 损失只是 KL 散度的上界，最小化它并不保证生成样本的“公平性”（与真实分布 i.i.d. 采样一致）。因此需要超越聚合式泛化指标，考察更局部的、面向训练数据的偏置或记忆痕迹，尤其是在隐私关键场景下。
AI.method: 采用“双管齐下”策略。(1) 真实图像实验：CelebA 灰度 32×32，DDPM + U-Net 预测噪声；将数据划分为互不重叠的两半分别训练（sample-split analysis），在相同噪声轨迹下比较生成样本间的余弦距离（样本层面）以及固定扩散时刻上两模型噪声预测的余弦相似度（score 层面）；定义最近邻发散度（NN divergence，即生成分布与 i.i.d. 真实样本最近邻距离分布之间的 KL）。(2) 受控层次数据模型：用上下文无关文法的树结构生成离散序列（q=6, 有效 q̃=4, ℓ=4 层, N=16），one-hot 编码后加连续高斯扩散，T=500，transformer 编码器作为去噪器并用交叉熵训练；利用信念传播（BP）精确计算真实后验均值 E[x0|x_t]，以及按层级过滤得到的粗化 oracle BP_k 用于分层特征诊断；比较 KL 损失分解（exact distillation 项 + excess data-dependent 项）、U-turn 实验（对训练/测试起点分别做往返并以 BP 为参照计算重叠比）。(3) 无训练的玩具模型：以“锐度”参数 ε 平滑经验分布，构造单参数可解析生成模型，展示相同现象。
AI.result: (1) 在 CelebA 上，两条互斥数据分片训练的模型的生成样本余弦距离呈 U 形，其最小值出现在训练早期，远早于测试损失最小值；此时标准“复制”判据（Yoon 等的 1/3 比率）最大值仍低于 10⁻³，说明偏置早于显式记忆出现。score 层面：t=50、150 等输入依赖强的时刻，去噪器输出分歧在样本层面偏置起点附近即开始上升；在测试损失最小点，按“训练集/测试集”起点条件化的 score 距离曲线明显分离，证明去噪器已带训练数据偏置。(2) 层次数据模型中：模型与 oracle BP_0 的 KL 最小点（样本高效估计的测试损失最小点）晚于两模型 sample-split 分歧的起点；最近邻发散度与模型分歧起点一致。关键机制分析显示，模型依次逼近 BP_ℓ, BP_{ℓ-1}, …, 最优匹配层级 k*(n) 取决于训练样本量（n=5k 时 k*=2，12k 时 k*=1，70k 时逼近 BP_0），偏置恰在该最优匹配点之后开始：coarse 结构早期以“平均场”方式、与数据无关地学到，而更精细特征在统计量不足时只能以数据依赖方式近似，此时测试损失仍在下降。损失分解显示“excess data-dependent”项在测试集上期望为 0（不贡献测试损失），却在训练集上有限且可被优化，因而测试损失下降与数据偏置可以同时发生。U-turn 实验直接给出动力学证据：测试损失最小点时，训练集起点的重建重叠显著高于测试集起点。(3) 无训练玩具模型同样出现宽广的偏置泛化区间，表明现象并非神经网络归纳偏置或 SGD 动力学的产物。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型中泛化与记忆可共存，表现为正交而非相反的行为轴：偏置泛化阶段先于测试损失最小点出现，其根源是深层网络特征学习的序贯性——粗结构先被与数据无关地学到，更精细结构在统计量不足时以越来越依赖个体训练样本的方式被近似。因此，最小化与数据生成过程的分布差异本身并不能阻止向有限训练集的有偏采样；在测试损失最小处早停对于隐私关键应用可能不足，需要引入面向样本层面的偏置度量（如 sample-split score 分歧、最近邻发散度、U-turn 重叠）作为补充诊断。作者声明局限：仅研究标准 DDPM，未涉及离散扩散/自回归模型，未提出缓解策略，偏置度量基于邻近性与 score，无法刻画语义级记忆；并提出未来方向为考察 classifier-free guidance 等条件化/引导技术是否放大这种数据依赖偏置。

title: LikeThis! Empowering App Users to Submit UI Improvement Suggestions Instead of Complaints
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE '26)
summary: User feedback is crucial for the evolution of mobile apps. However, research suggests that users tend to submit uninformative, vague, or destructive feedback. Unlike recent AI4SE approaches that focus on generating code and other development artifacts, our work aims at empowering users to submit better and more constructive UI feedback with concrete suggestions on how to improve the app. We propose LikeThis!, a GenAI-based approach that takes a user comment with the corresponding screenshot to immediately generate multiple improvement alternatives, from which the user can easily choose their preferred option. To evaluate LikeThis!, we first conducted a model benchmarking study based on a public dataset of carefully critiqued UI designs. The results show that GPT-Image-1 significantly outperformed three other state-of-the-art image generation models in improving the designs to address UI issues while keeping the fidelity and without introducing new issues. An intermediate step in LikeThis! is to generate a solution specification before sketching the design as a key to achieving effective improvement. Second, we conducted a user study with 10 production apps, where 15 users used LikeThis! to submit their feedback on encountered issues. Later, the developers of the apps assessed the understandability and actionability of the feedback with and without generated improvements. The results show that our approach helps generate better feedback from both user and developer perspectives, paving the way for AI-assisted user-developer collaboration.

AI.tldr: LikeThis!是一种基于生成式AI的UI反馈改进工具，通过用户评论和截图生成多个改进方案。GPT-Image-1在UI设计改进任务中表现最佳。用户研究表明该方法显著提升了反馈的可理解性和可操作性。
AI.motivation: 用户反馈对移动应用演进至关重要，但用户倾向于提交不清晰、模糊或破坏性的反馈。现有的AI4SE方法侧重于生成代码等开发产物，而本文旨在帮助用户提交更好、更具建设性的UI反馈。
AI.method: 提出LikeThis!，一个基于生成式AI的方法。该方法接收用户评论和相应截图，生成多个改进方案供用户选择。关键技术贡献包括：(1)模型基准测试表明GPT-Image-1在改进UI设计方面显著优于其他三种图像生成模型；(2)在生成设计草图前，先生成解决方案规范作为关键步骤。
AI.result: 模型基准测试：GPT-Image-1在解决UI问题的同时保持保真度且不引入新问题，显著优于其他三种模型。用户研究：10个生产应用，15名用户使用LikeThis!提交反馈，开发者评估了反馈的可理解性和可操作性。
AI.conclusion: LikeThis!从用户和开发者角度都能生成更好的反馈，为AI辅助的用户-开发者协作铺平了道路。

title: When Shallow Wins: Silent Failures and the Depth-Accuracy Paradox in Latent Reasoning
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Latent & Implicit Thinking - Going Beyond CoT Reasoning. 19 Pages and 5 Figures
summary: Mathematical reasoning models are widely deployed in education, automated tutoring, and decision support systems despite exhibiting fundamental computational instabilities. We demonstrate that state-of-the-art models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B) achieve 61% accuracy through a mixture of reliable and unreliable reasoning pathways: 18.4% of correct predictions employ stable, faithful reasoning while 81.6% emerge through computationally inconsistent pathways. Additionally, 8.8% of all predictions are silent failures -- confident yet incorrect outputs. Through comprehensive analysis using novel faithfulness metrics, we reveal: (1) reasoning quality shows weak negative correlation with correctness (r=-0.21, p=0.002), reflecting a binary classification threshold artifact rather than a monotonic inverse relationship; (2) scaling from 1.5B to 7B parameters (4.7x increase) provides zero accuracy benefit on our evaluated subset (6% of GSM8K), requiring validation on the complete benchmark; and (3) latent reasoning employs diverse computational strategies, with ~20% sharing CoT-like patterns. These findings highlight that benchmark accuracy can mask computational unreliability, demanding evaluation reforms measuring stability beyond single-sample metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文以 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 GSM8K 的 500 题（全集 6%）子集上提出一套“潜在推理忠实度”复合指标（激活稳定性 S + 推理跳对齐 A + 深度效率 E，权重 0.35/0.35/0.30），配合噪声因果干预、信息瓶颈熵分析与轨迹相似度对比，声称 61% 的正确回答中仅 18.4% 走稳定忠实的推理路径、81.6% 来自计算不一致的“幸运猜测”，且 8.8% 为“高置信但错误”的静默失败；1.5B 与 7B 准确率完全相同（61%），隐式与显式 CoT 内部轨迹相似度均值仅 0.43（约 20% 题达到 ≥0.7），说明潜式推理并非压缩后的 CoT，而是多样化的策略组合。结论层面是一篇呼吁评测改革（关注跨次运行稳定性而非单样本准确率）的方法学/立场型论文，但样本量小、指标缺乏理论基础、正文与附录表格数据自相矛盾，结论强度需谨慎对待。
AI.motivation: 数学推理模型被大量部署到教育、自动辅导、评分与决策支持系统，但作者认为其 benchmark 准确率可能掩盖内部计算的不稳定性与“表面能力”（浅层模式匹配）。核心追问有三：隐式/潜在推理（latent reasoning）是否真的执行了必要的多步计算（RQ1 忠实度测量）；潜在推理是压缩后的 CoT 还是本质不同的计算策略（RQ2 压缩 vs 新颖性）；模型能否通过稳定与不稳定两条路径同时取得高准确率及其部署含义（RQ3 计算可靠性）。作者希望以激活层级的忠实度指标取代仅看单样本准确率的评测范式。
AI.method: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B（对比 1.5B）上取 500 道 GSM8K 题（s_i≥2 的多跳问题），做前向多次采样并提出复合忠实度指标：激活稳定性 S（两次前向的逐层展平余弦相似度均值 × 方差惩罚）、推理跳对齐 A（以 75 分位激活幅值变化检测跳变层集合 H，用 log 比值惩罚过度/不足利用）、深度效率 E（活跃层比例 0.4 + 跳变密度 0.3 + 幅值变异系数 tanh 0.3，与 D_opt=min(s/L,1) 的偏离度），加权得 F=0.35S+0.35A+0.30E，阈值 τ_F=0.60、τ_S=0.65、τ_E=0.60 判为忠实。另用逐层高斯噪声注入的因果重要性 γ_ℓ 定位关键层；用 50 桶归一化直方图熵找信息瓶颈层；统计 thinking token（151646）使用率；在 Implicit / Explicit CoT / Concise 三种推理模式下比较层幅值轨迹余弦相似度以检验压缩假说（SR≥0.75 支持，SR<0.5 否定）；以正确性 × 稳定性划分 TRUE_POSITIVE / LUCKY_GUESS / TRUE_NEGATIVE / SILENT_FAILURE 四种失效模式；用深度分位数分箱检验“深度-准确率悖论”；做 Pearson/Spearman 相关、bootstrap CI 与阈值 ±0.05 敏感性分析。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 7B 在该子集准确率 61%，平均 F=0.671，但仅约 20% 响应满足严格忠实度判据，正确预测中 18.4%（56 例）稳定忠实、81.6%（249 例）走不一致路径；四模式分布为 11.2% True Positive、49.8% Lucky Guess、30.2% True Negative、8.8% Silent Failure。(2) F 与正确性弱负相关 r=-0.21（p=0.002），实为二值阈值伪影——连续形式 AUROC=0.78（正确组 F̄=0.79 vs 错误组 0.56）；推理步数与准确率 r=-0.27。(3) 显式 CoT 准确率 58.5%→68.5%（+10pp），但深度仅差 0.01、跳变层数同为 7、熵 0.089→0.084，暗示 verbalization 改善的是“对齐”而非“深度”。(4) 激活幅值在 0–18 层平坦（<500）、19–28 层骤增（峰值≈1200），关键层集中在 20–28；但噪声干预显示中层 6–9 最重要（layer 6 γ=0.34），呈“中层因果 + 晚期放大”的两阶段结构，部分层（0、18、21、27）γ 为负。(5) 隐式与简洁 CoT 轨迹相似度均值 0.43，仅约 20% 题 ≥0.7，否定“压缩 CoT”假说，指向随难度变化的多策略组合。(6) 熵分析显示早/中层高熵、19–27 层强压缩，与信息瓶颈一致。(7) 跨模型：1.5B 与 7B 准确率完全相同（61%），7B 深度 +7.2%、熵低 88%（0.090 vs 0.169），跳变层同为 7；thinking token 使用量 <0.05/题，说明推理主要在标准激活空间完成而非专用 token 机制。(8) 消融显示去掉稳定性分量后忠实度最高（0.72），各配置相关均为负。附录 Table 5/6 的失效模式与消融数据与正文叙述互相矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：benchmark 准确率会掩盖计算不可靠性——“浅层胜利”——61% 的正确回答来自不稳定路径，8.8% 静默失败构成高风险场景的部署隐患（ brittleness、跨次运行不可复现、评测-部署错配）。作者主张评测从单样本准确率转向跨次运行稳定性与多样本一致性，提出多采样一致（≥3 次）、稳定性阈值（S<0.65 触发人工复核）、稳定性加权评分、向用户暴露置信度等部署规范，并呼吁与显式 CoT/思维 token/循环机制对比的连续型、有理论基础的忠实度指标。需要强调的局限：仅评测 GSM8K 的 6%（500 题），指标缺乏形式化理论保证（权重与阈值为经验选取），稳定性估计需多次前向导致大模型扩展性受限，噪声因果干预粒度粗（宜用 activation patching），且仅覆盖单一模型家族；因此缩放律与“深度-准确率悖论”的普适性结论必须在完整基准上复验。

title: From Threat Intelligence to Firewall Rules: Semantic Relations in Hybrid AI Agent and Expert System Architectures
summary: Web security demands rapid response capabilities to evolving cyber threats. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) promises automation, but the need for trustworthy security responses is of the utmost importance. This work investigates the role of semantic relations in extracting information for sensitive operational tasks, such as configuring security controls for mitigating threats. To this end, it proposes to leverage hypernym-hyponym textual relations to extract relevant information from Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reports. By leveraging a neuro-symbolic approach, the multi-agent system automatically generates CLIPS code for an expert system creating firewall rules to block malicious network traffic. Experimental results show the superior performance of the hypernym-hyponym retrieval strategy compared to various baselines and the higher effectiveness of the agentic approach in mitigating threats.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经-符号结合的多智能体架构：利用 LLM 从网络威胁情报（CTI）报告中通过「下位词-上位词（hyponym-hyponym/hypernym）」语义关系迭代抽取安全概念，再自动生成 CLIPS 专家系统代码来配置 iptables 防火墙规则以阻断恶意流量。实验表明该语义检索策略在多标签分类上优于 Word2Vec/GloVe/SecureBERT、CoT 及传统机器学习基线（加权 F1 约提升 7%），生成规则经安全专家人工评估获得满意的一致性（Krippendorff's α 约 0.5–0.58）。
AI.motivation: Web 应用因公网可达性成为攻击目标，攻击者借助 AI 工具自动化利用漏洞，形成"攻击者只需攻破少数弱点、防御者须保护全系统"的结构性不对称，导致威胁响应存在严重延迟。IDS/IPS 的部署效果取决于对安全控制项的正确选择与配置，而这一过程依赖对事件报告与攻击者行为技术的准确理解。现有 AI 方法难以自动对敏感数据进行归类，尤其在 CTI 标注数据极度类别不平衡的低资源场景下性能显著下降；同时 LLM 直接从原始文本映射到分类或代码生成时缺乏显式结构化语义知识，易受幻觉影响，难以满足可信安全响应的要求。
AI.method:
（1）语义抽取方法：提出基于上下位关系的三阶段迭代提示策略——先抽取具体领域实体，再抽象为语义类别，最后基于丰富表示执行具体操作；关键创新是先用 LLM 迭代调用检索 CTI 文本中安全概念的下位词（hyponyms）再检索上位词（hypernyms），并将结果注入提示模板。与需额外训练数据引入本体结构的方法不同，该方法是纯推理时（inference-based）的，并引入置信度阈值以调节选择性约束强度。
（2）神经-符号架构（Semantic Information Flow）：扩展 CoALA 框架，集成心理学理论（Ebbinghaus 记忆衰减、Collins & Quillian 语义网络），构建图结构知识库跟踪概念以支持代码生成（相较决策树更易增量更新）；使用 CLIPS 前向链推理引擎。
（3）双专家系统校验：Expert System A 作为对 LLM 幻觉的句法验证层；通过模板、事实与产生式规则（production rules）的顺序实例化实现错误传播的系统性检测；Refinement Engine 中 Expert System B 依据所需 security capabilities 与生成的 CLIPS 规则产出最终过滤规则（iptables），做最终句法正确性校验以确保被安全控制接受。
（4）确定性推理：固定随机种子、关闭 CuDNN benchmarking、强制 eager attention、贪心解码与显式设备放置，作为确定性的启发式做法。
（5）数据集：Dataset A（CTI-HAL，81 份真实报告、116 个 MITRE ATT&CK 技术、人工标注一致性评估）用于多标签分类；Dataset B（CIS 的 66 条恶意软件条目，含分析师概要与网络工件，标签为 security capabilities）用于端到端流水线与专家评估。模型为 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct（因 Foundation-Sec-14B-Instruct 的生成限制与 CLIPS 支持不足而被弃用）。评估指标含加权 F1、准确率、Top-k 准确率、BERTScore、ROUGE-L，以及 Hamming loss 等面向不平衡多标签的指标。
AI.result:
Task A（Dataset A，多标签分类）：本文方法最优——加权 F1 0.329、准确率 0.934、Top-10 准确率 0.968、ROUGE-L 0.444；对比 CoT（F1 0.308、Top-10 0.935）、Label Powerset SVM（0.263）、Binary Relevance RF（0.183）、SecureBERT+RF（0.143）、GloVe（0.118）、NB+OvR（0.122）、SVM+OvR（0.062）、SecureBERT（0.043）、Word2Vec（0.070）。CoT 的准确率相近但加权 F1 明显更差，源于少数类表现弱，说明本文方法在不平衡数据上更鲁棒（约 7% F1 增益）。语义层面 BERTScore 与 ROUGE-L 确认所选文本片段的切合度最高。
Task A 提示消融（Table 3）：三阶段 50% 阈值最佳（F1 0.329）；Few-Shot+Hyponyms 0.311；CoT+Hypernyms 0.308；CoT 基线 0.308；CoT+Hyponyms 0.294；60% 阈值 Top-10 达 1.000 但 F1 降至 0.288；Zero-Shot 变体最差（0.238/0.233）；仅用语义信息的基线 F1 仅 0.173。结论：下位词一致优于上位词；较弱选择性约束（阈值 50%）更佳。
Task B（Dataset B 端到端，安全专家人工评估）：多维度标注者一致性良好——技术正确性 Krippendorff's α = 0.5768（各权重下），对 CTI 的忠实度 α = 0.5215，范围校准 α = 0.5030 且取得最高 Spearman ρ（0.7251/0.7143），表明规则语法正确、范围排序一致、对源 CTI 的对应关系满意。
AI.conclusion: 结论：本文在入侵防御系统（IPS）场景下验证了以 CLIPS 代码生成防火墙规则的 agentic 流水线可行性。语义（上下位关系）增强的提示式抽取方法显著优于静态/上下文嵌入、提示基线与传统机器学习分类，凸显了在 IDS 场景中引入专用语义检索模块（而非经典分类范式）的必要性。Task B 的人工评估显示专家间一致性良好，说明该系统具备进一步实用化与部署的前景，可为基于 LLM 的过滤规则下游使用（如规则调优、误报控制）奠定基础。作者明确指出：当前智能体系统面向研究用途，LLM 的确定性仅为启发式近似而非严格保证，未来需深入研究真正的确定性推理；同时该工作是迈向在网络安全等敏感领域更可靠地使用 LLM 的初步探索。

title: Minimax Optimal Strategy for Delayed Observations in Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study reinforcement learning with delayed state observation, where the agent observes the current state after some random number of time steps. We propose an algorithm that combines the augmentation method and the upper confidence bound approach. For tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), we derive a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max} SAK})$, where $S$ and $A$ are the cardinalities of the state and action spaces, $H$ is the time horizon, $K$ is the number of episodes, and $D_{\max}$ is the maximum length of the delay. We also provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, showing the optimality of our approach. Our analytical framework formulates this problem as a special case of a broader class of MDPs, where their transition dynamics decompose into a known component and an unknown but structured component. We establish general results for this abstract setting, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 研究延迟状态观测下的强化学习，结合增强方法和上置信界方法，在表格MDP中获得近乎最优的遗憾界$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max}SAK})$，并证明其下界匹配。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中实际场景下智能体观测状态存在延迟，现有方法未充分处理该问题，需设计能在延迟环境下有效学习的算法。
AI.method: 结合增强方法(augmentation method)与上置信界(UCB)方法，将延迟观测问题建模为过渡动态分解为已知组件和未知但结构化组件的MDP特例。
AI.result: 针对表格MDP得到遗憾界$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max}SAK})$，其中$S$为状态空间大小，$A$为动作空间大小，$H$为时间 horizon，$K$为回合数，$D_{\max}$为最大延迟长度。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在表格MDP中达到最优（除对数因子外），建立的抽象框架可推广到更一般的过渡动态分解问题。

title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic AI for WebGIS Development
comment: Paper submitted to Transactions in GIS
summary: WebGIS development requires rigor, yet agentic AI frequently fails due to five large language model (LLM) limitations: context constraints, cross-session forgetting, stochasticity, instruction failure, and adaptation rigidity. We propose a dual-helix governance framework reframing these challenges as structural governance problems that model capacity alone cannot resolve. We implement the framework as a 3-track architecture (Knowledge, Behavior, Skills) that uses a knowledge graph substrate to stabilize execution by externalizing domain facts and enforcing executable protocols, complemented by a self-learning cycle for autonomous knowledge growth. Applying this to the FutureShorelines WebGIS tool, a governed agent refactored a 2,265-line monolithic codebase into modular ES6 components. Results demonstrated a 51\% reduction in cyclomatic complexity and a 7-point increase in maintainability index. A comparative experiment against a zero-shot LLM confirms that externalized governance, not just model capability, drives operational reliability in geospatial engineering. This approach is implemented in the open-source AgentLoom governance toolkit.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双螺旋治理框架，通过知识图谱 substrate 和三轨架构（知识、行为、技能）解决agentic AI在WebGIS开发中的五大LLM局限性，并将2,265行单体代码重构为模块化ES6组件，使圈复杂度降低51%，可维护性指数提升7点。
AI.motivation: WebGIS开发需要严谨性，但agentic AI常因五大LLM局限性而失败：上下文约束、跨会话遗忘、随机性、指令失败和适应僵化。这些问题无法仅通过模型容量提升来解决，需要重新定义为结构性治理问题。
AI.method: 提出双螺旋治理框架，实现为三轨架构（知识、行为、技能）：（1）知识图谱substrate外化领域事实并强制执行可执行协议以稳定执行；（2）自学习循环实现自主知识增长。应用于FutureShorelines WebGIS工具，并进行零样本LLM对比实验。
AI.result: 治理后的agent将2,265行单体代码重构为模块化ES6组件；圈复杂度降低51%；可维护性指数提升7点；对比实验证实外部化治理而非仅模型能力决定地理空间工程中的操作可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 外部化治理而非单纯提升模型能力是驱动地理空间工程操作可靠性的关键。该方法已开源实现为AgentLoom治理工具包。

title: Generative AI in Managerial Decision-Making: Redefining Boundaries through Ambiguity Resolution and Sycophancy Analysis
summary: Generative artificial intelligence is increasingly being integrated into complex business workflows, fundamentally shifting the boundaries of managerial decision-making. However, the reliability of its strategic advice in ambiguous business contexts remains a critical knowledge gap. This study addresses this by comparing various models on ambiguity detection, evaluating how a systematic resolution process enhances response quality, and investigating their sycophantic behavior when presented with flawed directives. Using a novel four-dimensional business ambiguity taxonomy, we conducted a human-in-the-loop experiment across strategic, tactical, and operational scenarios. The resulting decisions were assessed with an "LLM-as-a-judge" framework on criteria including agreement, actionability, justification quality, and constraint adherence. Results reveal distinct performance capabilities. While models excel in detecting internal contradictions and contextual ambiguities, they struggle with structural linguistic nuances. Ambiguity resolution consistently increased response quality across all decision types, while sycophantic behavior analysis revealed distinct patterns depending on the model architecture. This study contributes to the bounded rationality literature by positioning GAI as a cognitive scaffold that can detect and resolve ambiguities managers might overlook, but whose own artificial limitations necessitate human management to ensure its reliability as a strategic partner.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了大语言模型在商业模糊性检测、解决和响应质量方面的表现。通过四维业务模糊性分类法和"LLM即评判者"实验框架，发现模型擅长检测内部矛盾但struggle with结构语言 nuances，模糊性解决能提升响应质量，不同架构表现出不同的谄媚行为模式。研究将GAI定位为辅助管理者决策的认知脚手架，但强调需人类监督确保其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能正被整合到复杂商业工作流程中，但其在模糊商业情境中提供战略建议的可靠性存在关键知识空白。现有研究尚未系统评估大语言模型在业务 ambiguity（模糊性）检测和解决方面的能力。
AI.method: 采用四维业务模糊性分类法，开展跨战略、战术和运营场景的人机协作实验。运用"LLM即评判者"框架，从一致性、可操作性、论证质量和约束遵守四个维度评估模型决策表现。
AI.result: 1. 模型在检测内部矛盾和情境模糊性方面表现出色，但在结构语言细微差别处理上存在困难；2. 模糊性解决过程一致地提高了所有决策类型的响应质量；3. 谄媚行为分析揭示了不同模型架构的独特模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究将GAI定位为认知脚手架工具，可检测和解决管理者可能忽略的业务模糊性，但其自身的人工局限性需要人类管理来确保作为战略伙伴的可靠性。研究为有限理性文献做出贡献，揭示了当前大语言模型在商业场景应用中的能力边界和改进方向。

title: Optimal trajectory-guided stochastic co-optimization for e-fuel system design and real-time operation
summary: E-fuels are promising long-term energy carriers supporting the net-zero transition. However, the large combinatorial design-operation spaces under renewable uncertainty make the use of mathematical programming impractical for co-optimizing e-fuel production systems. Here, we present MasCOR, a machine-learning-assisted co-optimization framework that learns from global operational trajectories. By encoding system design and renewable trends, a single MasCOR agent generalizes dynamic operation across diverse configurations and scenarios, substantially simplifying design-operation co-optimization under uncertainty. Benchmark comparisons against state-of-the-art reinforcement learning baselines demonstrate near-optimal performance, while computational costs are substantially lower than those of mathematical programming, enabling rapid parallel evaluation of designs within the co-optimization loop. This framework enables rapid screening of feasible design spaces together with corresponding operational policies. When applied to four potential European sites targeting e-methanol production, MasCOR shows that most locations benefit from reducing system load below 50 MW to achieve carbon-neutral methanol production, with production costs of 1.0-1.2 USD per kg. In contrast, Dunkirk (France), with limited renewable availability and high grid prices, favors system loads above 200 MW and expanded storage to exploit dynamic grid exchange and hydrogen sales to the market. These results underscore the value of the MasCOR framework for site-specific guidance from system design to real-time operation.

AI.tldr: MasCOR是一种机器学习辅助的协同优化框架，用于解决电燃料生产系统在可再生能源不确定性下的设计-运行协同优化问题。该框架通过学习全局运行轨迹，能够跨不同配置和场景推广动态运行策略。
AI.motivation: 电燃料是支撑净零转型的有前景的长期能源载体，但在可再生能源不确定性下，庞大的组合设计-运行空间使得数学规划方法变得不切实际，亟需一种能够快速评估设计空间同时考虑运行策略的方法。
AI.method: 提出MasCOR框架，通过编码系统设计和可再生能源趋势，从全局运行轨迹中学习，使单个智能体能够跨不同配置和场景推广动态运行，从而简化不确定性下的设计-运行协同优化。
AI.result: 与强化学习基准相比，MasCOR达到接近最优性能，计算成本显著低于数学规划方法，可实现设计空间的快速并行评估。应用于四个欧洲甲醇生产场地，证明大多数地点适合将系统负荷降至50 MW以下以实现碳中和甲醇生产，成本为1.0-1.2美元/公斤；而敦刻尔克因可再生能源有限和电价高，适合超过200 MW的系统负荷并扩展储能以利用动态电网交换和氢气市场销售。
AI.conclusion: MasCOR框架能够为从系统设计到实时运行的各场地提供特定指导，证明了机器学习辅助协同优化在复杂能源系统中的实用价值。

title: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B Technical Report
summary: We present Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B, a compact open-weight multimodal reasoning model, and share the motivations, design choices, experiments, and learnings that informed its development. Our goal is to contribute practical insight to the research community on building smaller, efficient multimodal reasoning models and to share the result of these learnings as an open-weight model that is good at common vision and language tasks and excels at scientific and mathematical reasoning and understanding user interfaces. Our contributions include demonstrating that careful architecture choices and rigorous data curation enable smaller, open-weight multimodal models to achieve competitive performance with significantly less training and inference-time compute and tokens. The most substantial improvements come from systematic filtering, error correction, and synthetic augmentation -- reinforcing that data quality remains the primary lever for model performance. Systematic ablations show that high-resolution, dynamic-resolution encoders yield consistent improvements, as accurate perception is a prerequisite for high-quality reasoning. Finally, a hybrid mix of reasoning and non-reasoning data with explicit mode tokens allows a single model to deliver fast direct answers for simpler tasks and chain-of-thought reasoning for complex problems.

AI.tldr: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B是一个紧凑的开源多模态推理模型，通过精心架构设计、严格数据筛选、高分辨率编码器和混合推理数据策略，实现了在较少计算资源下达到竞争性性能的目标，证明了数据质量是模型性能的主要杠杆。
AI.motivation: 构建更小、更高效的多模态推理模型，使研究社区能够获得在常见视觉语言任务以及科学数学推理和UI理解方面表现出色的开源权重模型，同时贡献关于如何用较少训练和推理计算资源实现竞争性性能的实际见解。
AI.method: 1) 采用紧凑的模型架构设计；2) 系统性数据过滤、错误纠正和合成增强以提升数据质量；3) 使用高分辨率动态分辨率编码器改善感知能力；4) 混合推理与非推理数据并引入显式模式标记实现灵活推理
AI.result: 成功开发了Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B模型，验证了小型开放权重多模态模型通过精心的架构设计和严格的数据筛选可以在较少计算资源下达到与大型模型相当的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的架构选择和严格的数据筛选，Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B模型能够在更少的训练和推理计算资源下达到具有竞争力的性能表现。高分辨率动态分辨率编码器是提升推理能力的关键，数据质量仍是模型性能的主要驱动因素。混合推理与非推理数据并使用显式模式标记的方法，使单一模型能够同时处理简单和复杂任务。

title: When Small Variations Become Big Failures: Reliability Challenges in Compute-in-Memory Neural Accelerators
comment: 2026 International VLSI Symposium on Technology, Systems and Applications (VLSI TSA)
summary: Compute-in-memory (CiM) architectures promise significant improvements in energy efficiency and throughput for deep neural network acceleration by alleviating the von Neumann bottleneck. However, their reliance on emerging non-volatile memory devices introduces device-level non-idealities-such as write variability, conductance drift, and stochastic noise-that fundamentally challenge reliability, predictability, and safety, especially in safety-critical applications. This talk examines the reliability limits of CiM-based neural accelerators and presents a series of techniques that bridge device physics, architecture, and learning algorithms to address these challenges. We first demonstrate that even small device variations can lead to disproportionately large accuracy degradation and catastrophic failures in safety-critical inference workloads, revealing a critical gap between average-case evaluations and worst-case behavior. Building on this insight, we introduce SWIM, a selective write-verify mechanism that strategically applies verification only where it is most impactful, significantly improving reliability while maintaining CiM's efficiency advantages. Finally, we explore a learning-centric solution that improves realistic worst-case performance by training neural networks with right-censored Gaussian noise, aligning training assumptions with hardware-induced variability and enabling robust deployment without excessive hardware overhead. Together, these works highlight the necessity of cross-layer co-design for CiM accelerators and provide a principled path toward dependable, efficient neural inference on emerging memory technologies-paving the way for their adoption in safety- and reliability-critical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文（综述/汇总型论文）总结了基于非易失性存储的存算一体（NVCiM）神经网络加速器在可靠性方面的三项互补工作：(1) 最坏情况刻画——证明即使微小的器件波动（写波动、电导漂移、随机噪声）也会在安全关键推理中导致灾难性失效（最坏情况错误率接近 100%），而蒙特卡洛平均精度评估（即使 10 万次）会严重低估尾部风险；(2) 硬件方案 SWIM——在预算约束下按损失敏感度排序，仅对最关键权重器件选择性执行写验证，在保持能效优势的同时提升可靠性；(3) 软件方案 TRICE——用右删失高斯噪声训练网络，通过优化 k 阶百分位性能（KPP，k=1）改善现实最坏情况鲁棒性且无需额外硬件开销。核心结论是 NVCiM 的可靠部署必须依赖安全关键指标与跨层（器件-架构-算法）协同设计。
AI.motivation: 存算一体（CiM）架构通过减少数据搬运缓解冯·诺依曼瓶颈，能显著提升深度神经网络推理的能效与吞吐。但其依赖新型非易失性存储器（NVM），器件级非理想性（读噪声、电导漂移、写波动）会给部署的模型权重注入噪声，直接威胁可靠性、可预测性与安全性。现有研究多以平均情况（average-case）精度报告鲁棒性，但安全关键应用（如自动驾驶）真正决定风险的是罕见但可能出现的器件波动组合，极易引发大规模精度崩塌甚至灾难性失效。高维波动空间使朴素蒙特卡洛采样难以捕捉真实尾部行为，因此需要尾部分布感知的评估方法与有针对性的缓解手段，这是本文立项的直接动因。
AI.method: 跨层协同设计，方法分三部分：(1) 最坏情况可靠性评估：将最坏情况评估形式化为带约束的优化问题，即在写验证所界定的扰动范数 ℒ(ΔW) ≤ th_g 内，搜索使推理错误样本数 |{f(W+ΔW,x)=t}| 最大的权重噪声配置 ΔW；并与蒙特卡洛平均结果对比以量化尾部盲区。(2) SWIM（选择性写验证）：把选择性写验证建模为预算约束下的选择问题——给定映射后模型与性能目标（如允许精度下降 ΔAcc 或最低精度阈值），寻找最小验证权重子集以满足变化下的精度要求，同时最小化归一化写周期开销；放弃按权重幅值或层级顺序等朴素启发式，改用基于泰勒展开的损失敏感度指标计算各权重对目标的贡献，按敏感度降序在硬件感知粒度（如编程组/行）上执行写验证，直至满足精度约束。(3) TRICE（基于右删失高斯噪声的训练）：以 k 阶百分位性能（KPP，即仅最差 k% 变化样本低于其下的精度阈值）作为现实最坏情况代理指标；通过权重扰动下损失/梯度的泰勒分析论证未删失高斯尾部会主导优化却无助于百分位指标，故在训练中注入右删失高斯噪声作为即插即用方法，无需额外硬件开销。
AI.result: (1) 揭示了"小波动→大失效"的放大效应：在写验证约束下的实际 NVCiM 场景中，个体扰动虽小，联合最坏情况配置在代表性网络与数据集上可使误差接近 100%；而 MC 采样即使运行 10 万次、平均统计量看似"收敛"，仍与尾部失效存在巨大差距。(2) 指出现有以平均性能为目标的缓解策略（如平均精度提升技术）直接推广到最坏情况可靠性时可能出人意料地无效。(3) SWIM 在预算内仅验证最关键器件，显著提升可靠性同时保留 CiM 的能效/效率优势；基于损失敏感度的排序明显优于幅值/层序启发式。(4) TRICE 在不同模型与波动强度下持续改善 KPP（k=1），且不引入额外硬件开销。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的 NVCiM 部署不能仅依赖平均精度评估，必须引入安全关键（尾部/最坏情况）指标，并需要器件、体系结构与学习算法三个层面的跨层协同设计：最坏情况评估暴露小器件波动下的灾难性尾部失效；硬件侧的 SWIM 通过预算化选择性写验证缓解失效；软件侧的右删失噪声注入通过优化 k 阶百分位性能提升现实最坏情况鲁棒性。三者共同为安全与可靠性关键系统采用新兴存储技术提供了原则化路径。

title: BeamPERL: Parameter-Efficient RL with Verifiable Rewards Specializes Compact LLMs for Structured Beam Mechanics Reasoning
summary: Can reinforcement learning with hard, verifiable rewards teach a compact language model to reason about physics, or does it primarily learn to pattern-match toward correct answers? We study this question by training a 1.5B-parameter reasoning model on beam statics, a classic engineering problem, using parameter-efficient RLVR with binary correctness rewards from symbolic solvers, without teacher-generated reasoning traces. The best BeamPERL checkpoint achieves a 66.7% improvement in Pass@1 over the base model. However, the learned competence is anisotropic: the model generalizes compositionally (more loads) but fails under topological shifts (moved supports) that require the same equilibrium equations. Intermediate checkpoints yield the strongest reasoning, while continued optimization degrades robustness while maintaining reward. These findings reveal a key limitation of outcome-level alignment: reinforcement learning with exact physics rewards induces procedural solution templates rather than internalization of governing equations. The precision of the reward signal - even when analytically exact - does not by itself guarantee transferable physical reasoning. Our results suggest that verifiable rewards may need to be paired with structured reasoning scaffolding to move beyond template matching toward robust scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究使用参数高效强化学习(RLVR)和符号求解器生成的二元正确性奖励，训练1.5B参数模型解决梁静力学问题。虽然最佳模型Pass@1提升66.7%，但学习能力呈各向异性：可组合推广（更多载荷）却无法拓扑泛化（移动支座）。结果表明精确奖励信号本身不足以保证可迁移的物理推理，验证性奖励需与结构化推理支架结合。
AI.motivation: 探索强化学习与硬验证奖励能否教compact语言模型进行物理推理，还是主要学会对正确答案进行模式匹配。聚焦梁静力学这一经典工程问题。
AI.method: 使用参数高效的RLVR方法，基于符号求解器生成的二元正确性奖励训练1.5B参数推理模型，不依赖教师生成的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 最佳BeamPERL检查点相比基线模型Pass@1提升66.7%。学习能力呈各向异性：可组合推广（增加载荷数量）但拓扑迁移（移动支座）失败，后者需相同的平衡方程。中间检查点推理能力最强，持续优化降低鲁棒性但维持奖励。
AI.conclusion: 结果级对齐有关键局限性：精确物理奖励的强化学习诱导程序化解题模板，而非内化控制方程。奖励信号的精确性本身不能保证可迁移的物理推理。验证性奖励需与结构化推理支架配对，才能超越模板匹配，实现稳健的科学推理。

title: Solving adversarial examples requires solving exponential misalignment
summary: Adversarial attacks - input perturbations imperceptible to humans that fool neural networks - remain both a persistent failure mode in machine learning, and a phenomenon with mysterious origins. To shed light, we define and analyze a network's perceptual manifold (PM) for a class concept as the space of all inputs confidently assigned to that class by the network. We find, strikingly, that the dimensionalities of neural network PMs are orders of magnitude higher than those of natural human concepts. Since volume typically grows exponentially with dimension, this suggests exponential misalignment between machines and humans, with exponentially many inputs confidently assigned to concepts by machines but not humans. Furthermore, this provides a natural geometric hypothesis for the origin of adversarial examples: because a network's PM fills such a large region of input space, any input will be very close to any class concept's PM. Our hypothesis thus suggests that adversarial robustness cannot be attained without dimensional alignment of machine and human PMs, and therefore makes strong predictions: both robust accuracy and distance to any PM should be negatively correlated with the PM dimension. We confirmed these predictions across 18 different networks of varying robust accuracy. Crucially, we find even the most robust networks are still exponentially misaligned, and only the few PMs whose dimensionality approaches that of human concepts exhibit alignment to human perception. Our results connect the fields of alignment and adversarial examples, and suggest the curse of high dimensionality of machine PMs is a major impediment to adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证：神经网络的“感知流形”(perceptual manifold, PM，即所有被网络高置信度判为某类别的输入集合)的维度，比人类自然概念流形高出一个数量级以上(CIFAR10 上 PR≈3060/3072、2NN≥500 vs 自然图像 PR≈10、2NN≈20；CLIP/ImageNet 上 PR≥135,000/150,528)，由此人类与机器之间存在"指数级错位"(exponential misalignment)；由于高维流形填满输入空间，任意输入都极其接近任一类别的 PM，这为对抗样本提供了统一的几何起源解释。对抗鲁棒性因而必须以"维度对齐"为前提：更鲁棒的模型 PM 维度更低、且到 PM 的距离更大(18 个网络验证)。即便最鲁棒模型仍处于指数级错位，只有维度接近人类概念的那些少数 PM 才出现感知对齐的"火花"。
AI.motivation: 对抗样本自 Szegedy et al. (2014) 发现以来十余年仍未解决，其几何成因长期不明(mysterious origins)；同时 AI 对齐(alignment)成为核心议题。作者试图用统一的"感知流形"框架解释:机器与人类在概念空间结构上存在严重错位,而对抗样本正是这种错位(尤其维度/体积层面)的直接后果,因此解决对抗样本问题在本质上是对齐问题的一个"预热案例"(prototypical warmup problem of misalignment)。
AI.method: 1) 定义 PM:分类器 PM_c = {x∈[0,1]^D : p(c|x)>p0}，默认 p0=0.9；CLIP 版本为余弦相似度水平集 PM_CLIP(t)={x: cos(f(x),g(t))≥c0}，取 c0=0.6(高于自然图像~0.3与噪声基线~0.25)。2) 用投影梯度上升(PGA)从均匀随机噪声采样 PM:交替做 log p(c|x) 梯度上升与超立方体投影，必要时切换 Adam、加动量/噪声，排除使用梯度掩蔽的模型。3) 两种维度度量:participation ratio (d_PR = tr(C)^2/tr(C^2)) 与 2NN 内蕴维度(Facco et al. 2017，报告值为下界)。4) 玩具模型理论:E[‖x-∂E‖²] ≈ (D-d)/6 + max{0, √(d/6)-R_eff}²(椭球 PM，距离随维度线性递减)，并与 Monte-Carlo 数值验证。5) 实验:18 个 RobustBench CIFAR10 模型 + ImageNet-1K 模型，比较 PM 维度、随机点到 PM 的 L2² 距离与 AutoAttack 鲁棒准确率；并做协方差谱/特征向量对齐(alignment score)/PSD 分析以及 PM 样本可视化。
AI.result: 1) 非鲁棒 WideResNet-28-10 (clean 94.78%, robust 0%) 的 PM 维度 PR≈3060/3072、2NN≥500，而自然图像类 PR≈10、2NN≈20；ImageNet 上标准 ResNet-50 的 PM 占据 >130,000/150,528 维。2) CLIP 同样错位:32×32 输入下 cat/truck 的 PM PR≈2650、2NN≥412/420；原生 224×224 下 PR≥135,000、2NN≥3,450，且与语义为空的"乱码"对照提示词统计上无差别，样本全为噪声。3) 玩具模型:低维椭球 PM 在 3072 维空间中到随机点平方距离≈500，全维时坍缩至≈50(随机两点为 512)。4) 18 个网络验证两项预测:PM 维度与 L∞ 鲁棒准确率负相关；PM 维度与到 PM 距离负相关(低维 PM 距离≈600，随维度升高衰减至 0)。最鲁棒模型 PR≈250、2NN≈150，仍远高于自然图像。5) 谱分析:自然图像协方差谱重尾(特征值 <1e-6)，标准模型谱尖锐近似各向同性(~1e-1)；鲁棒模型谱变宽但未恢复长尾；PM 特征向量与自然图像主成分仅略高于随机基线；PSD 上鲁棒模型谱斜率趋近 1/k² 但功率偏高。6) 样本层面:高维 PM 样本全为噪声，仅最鲁棒网络中维度最低的少数类别(PR≈80-140)出现可辨识的马、狗、鹿等语义"火花"。
AI.conclusion: 对抗样本的存在源于人类与机器感知流形之间的指数级错位，而非单纯的环境维度、数据维度或非鲁棒特征；其体积随维度指数增长导致 PM 填满输入空间，使任意输入都接近任一类别 PM，从而易被有界范数扰动攻破。因此要彻底解决对抗样本，必须训练出维度与人类概念流形相匹配的 PM(维度对齐)；即便当前最鲁棒模型也未做到，仍处指数级错位，提示在指数巨大的输入/词元空间中实现价值与意图对齐可能比解决对抗样本更难。作者还指出可将该框架推广到语言领域(以乱码 token 序列攻击 LLM)。

title: Towards Realistic Personalization: Evaluating Long-Horizon Preference Following in Personalized User-LLM Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly serving as personal assistants, where users share complex and diverse preferences over extended interactions. However, assessing how well LLMs can follow these preferences in realistic, long-term situations remains underexplored. This work proposes RealPref, a benchmark for evaluating realistic preference-following in personalized user-LLM interactions. RealPref features 100 user profiles, 1300 personalized preferences, four types of preference expression (ranging from explicit to implicit), and long-horizon interaction histories. It includes three types of test questions (multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended), with detailed rubrics for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Results indicate that LLM performance significantly drops as context length grows and preference expression becomes more implicit, and that generalizing user preference understanding to unseen scenarios poses further challenges. RealPref and these findings provide a foundation for future research to develop user-aware LLM assistants that better adapt to individual needs. The code is available at https://github.com/GG14127/RealPref.

AI.tldr: RealPref是一个用于评估LLM在个性化用户交互中遵循偏好的基准测试，包含100个用户画像、1300个个性化偏好、四种偏好表达类型和长视野交互历史。研究发现LLM性能随上下文长度增加和偏好表达更加隐含而显著下降。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为个人助手使用，用户在长期交互中分享复杂多样的偏好，但评估LLM在现实长期情境下遵循这些偏好的能力仍然缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: 构建RealPref基准测试，包含：100个用户画像、1300个个性化偏好、四种偏好表达类型（从显式到隐式）、长视野交互历史，以及三种测试问题类型（多项选择、正误和开放式），并设计了详细的LLM评判评分标准。
AI.result: LLM性能随上下文长度增加显著下降；偏好表达越隐含，性能下降越明显；将用户偏好理解泛化到未见过的场景存在额外挑战。
AI.conclusion: RealPref为未来研究提供了基础，有助于开发更能适应个体需求的用户感知型LLM助手。

title: Orbital Transformers for Predicting Wavefunctions in Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
summary: We aim to learn wavefunctions simulated by time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT), which can be efficiently represented as linear combination coefficients of atomic orbitals. In real-time TDDFT, the electronic wavefunctions of a molecule evolve over time in response to an external excitation, enabling first-principles predictions of physical properties such as optical absorption, electron dynamics, and high-order response. However, conventional real-time TDDFT relies on time-consuming propagation of all occupied states with fine time steps. In this work, we propose OrbEvo, which is based on an equivariant graph transformer architecture and learns to evolve the full electronic wavefunction coefficients across time steps. First, to account for external field, we design an equivariant conditioning to encode both strength and direction of external electric field and break the symmetry from SO(3) to SO(2). Furthermore, we design two OrbEvo models, OrbEvo-WF and OrbEvo-DM, using wavefunction pooling and density matrix as interaction method, respectively. Motivated by the central role of the density functional in TDDFT, OrbEvo-DM encodes the density matrix aggregated from all occupied electronic states into feature vectors via tensor contraction, providing a more intuitive approach to learn the time evolution operator. We adopt a training strategy specifically tailored to limit the error accumulation of time-dependent wavefunctions over autoregressive rollout. To evaluate our approach, we generate TDDFT datasets consisting of 5,000 different molecules in the QM9 dataset and 1,500 molecular configurations of the malonaldehyde molecule in the MD17 dataset. Results show that our OrbEvo model accurately captures quantum dynamics of excited states under external field, including time-dependent wavefunctions, time-dependent dipole moment, and optical absorption spectra.

AI.tldr: OrbEvo是一种基于等变图 transformer 的架构，用于学习实时TDDFT中电子波函数系数的时间演化。该模型通过等变条件编码外部电场，并分别采用波函数池化（OrbEvo-WF）和密度矩阵（OrbEvo-DM）两种交互方法，在QM9和MD17数据集上准确捕捉了激发态的量子动力学。
AI.motivation: 实时TDDFT能够从第一性原理预测光学吸收、电子动力学和高阶响应等物理性质，但传统方法需耗时的精细时间步传播所有占据态。OrbEvo旨在通过机器学习高效演化电子波函数系数，解决计算成本高昂的问题。
AI.method: OrbEvo采用等变图 transformer 架构学习跨时间步的电子波函数系数演化。设计等变条件编码外部电场的强度和方向，将对称性从SO(3)破缺至SO(2)。提出两种模型：OrbEvo-WF使用波函数池化，OrbEvo-DM通过张量收缩将所有占据态聚合的密度矩阵编码为特征向量。采用专门限制时间相关波函数误差累积的训练策略。
AI.result: 在QM9数据集的5000个不同分子和MD17数据集的1500个马龙醛分子构型上验证。OrbEvo准确捕捉了外场下激发态的量子动力学，包括时间相关波函数、时间相关偶极矩和光学吸收谱。
AI.conclusion: OrbEvo成功实现了对TDDFT中电子波函数时间演化的机器学习模拟，在保持较高精度的同时显著降低了计算成本，为高效模拟量子动力学提供了新途径。

title: Agentics 2.0: Logical Transduction Algebra for Agentic Data Workflows
summary: Agentic AI is rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to enterprise deployments, where requirements extend to meet the software quality attributes of reliability, scalability, and observability beyond plausible text generation. We present Agentics 2.0, a lightweight, Python-native framework for building high-quality, structured, explainable, and type-safe agentic data workflows. At the core of Agentics 2.0, the logical transduction algebra formalizes a large language model inference call as a typed semantic transformation, which we call a transducible function that enforces schema validity and the locality of evidence. The transducible functions compose into larger programs via algebraically grounded operators and execute as stateless asynchronous calls in parallel in asynchronous Map-Reduce programs. The proposed framework provides semantic reliability through strong typing, semantic observability through evidence tracing between slots of the input and output types, and scalability through stateless parallel execution. We instantiate reusable design patterns and evaluate the programs in Agentics 2.0 on challenging benchmarks, including DiscoveryBench for data-driven discovery and Archer for NL-to-SQL semantic parsing, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: Agentics 2.0是一个轻量级Python原生框架，用于构建高质量、结构化、可解释且类型安全的智能体数据工作流。其核心是通过逻辑转导代数将大语言模型推理形式化为类型化语义转换（可转导函数），支持组合执行和异步并行Map-Reduce计算。在DiscoveryBench和Archer基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI正从研究原型向企业部署转型，需要满足可靠性、可扩展性和可观测性等软件质量属性，而不仅仅是合理的文本生成。
AI.method: 提出逻辑转导代数(Logical Transduction Algebra)，将LLM推理调用形式化为类型化语义转换（可转导函数），强制执行模式有效性和证据局部性。可转导函数通过代数算子组合成更大程序，以无状态异步调用并行执行（异步Map-Reduce）。
AI.result: 通过强类型实现语义可靠性，通过输入输出槽位间的证据追踪实现语义可观测性，通过无状态并行执行实现可扩展性。在数据驱动发现基准DiscoveryBench和NL2SQL语义解析基准Archer上评估，达到了最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: Agentics 2.0框架能够构建高质量、结构化、可解释且类型安全的智能体数据工作流，为企业级智能体应用提供了理论基础和工程实践。

title: MMAI Gym for Science: Training Liquid Foundation Models for Drug Discovery
summary: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) that rely on in-context learning do not reliably deliver the scientific understanding and performance required for drug discovery tasks. Simply increasing model size or introducing reasoning tokens does not yield significant performance gains. To address this gap, we introduce the MMAI Gym for Science, a one-stop shop molecular data formats and modalities as well as task-specific reasoning, training, and benchmarking recipes designed to teach foundation models the 'language of molecules' in order to solve practical drug discovery problems. We use MMAI Gym to train an efficient Liquid Foundation Model (LFM) for these applications, demonstrating that smaller, purpose-trained foundation models can outperform substantially larger general-purpose or specialist models on molecular benchmarks. Across essential drug discovery tasks - including molecular optimization, ADMET property prediction, retrosynthesis, drug-target activity prediction, and functional group reasoning - the resulting model achieves near specialist-level performance and, in the majority of settings, surpasses larger models, while remaining more efficient and broadly applicable in the domain.

AI.tldr: 提出MMAI Gym分子科学训练平台，在此基础上训练的小型Liquid Foundation Model在药物发现多个任务上超越更大规模的通用或专业模型，验证了"小而精"路线在分子基础模型上的可行性
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型通过上下文学习无法可靠满足药物发现任务的科学理解和性能要求，单纯增加模型规模或引入推理token未能带来显著性能提升
AI.method: 开发MMAI Gym一站式平台，整合分子数据格式、任务专用推理、训练和基准测试方案；基于该平台训练高效的Liquid Foundation Model (LFM)
AI.result: LFM在分子优化、ADMET性质预测、逆合成分析、药物-靶点活性预测和官能团推理等关键任务上达到接近专家水平，大多数情况下超越更大规模的模型
AI.conclusion: 较小的专用基础模型可在分子基准测试中超越更大的通用模型，MMAI Gym为分子科学领域的基础模型训练提供了可扩展的标准化方案。

title: $τ$-Knowledge: Evaluating Conversational Agents over Unstructured Knowledge
summary: Conversational agents are increasingly deployed in knowledge-intensive settings, where correct behavior depends on retrieving and applying domain-specific knowledge from large, proprietary, and unstructured corpora during live interactions with users. Yet most existing benchmarks evaluate retrieval or tool use independently of each other, creating a gap in realistic, fully agentic evaluation over unstructured data in long-horizon interactions. We introduce $τ$-Knowledge, an extension of $τ$-Bench for evaluating agents in environments where success depends on coordinating external, natural-language knowledge with tool outputs to produce verifiable, policy-compliant state changes. Our new domain, $τ$-Banking, models realistic fintech customer support workflows in which agents must navigate roughly 700 interconnected knowledge documents while executing tool-mediated account updates. Across embedding-based retrieval and terminal-based search, even frontier models with high reasoning budgets achieve only $\sim$25.5% pass^1, with reliability degrading sharply over repeated trials. Agents struggle to retrieve the correct documents from densely interlinked knowledge bases and to reason accurately over complex internal policies. Overall, $τ$-Knowledge provides a realistic testbed for developing agents that integrate unstructured knowledge in human-facing deployments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 τ-Knowledge（τ-Bench 的扩展）与新领域 τ-Banking：在约 698 篇文档（≈19.5 万 token）的自然语言知识库上评测对话式智能体，要求智能体在长程对话中检索并应用非参数化知识，同时调用工具改变数据库状态（可发现工具需先"解锁"）。跨稠密/稀疏检索与终端搜索，最佳配置 pass^1 仅约 25.5%，最佳 pass^4 仅 13.4%；即便直接提供金标准文档（golden retriever），最高 pass^1 也只有 39.7%，说明瓶颈同时在检索与推理。论文强调"解法效率"（token、工具调用、时延、对话回退）应作为面向人类部署的核心指标。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测存在结构性缺口：多数基准要么单独评测检索（QA/网页搜索），要么单独评测工具调用/规划，且假设工具接口已完整给定；真实部署中智能体面对的是私有、非结构化、含分布外产品条款与内部协议的语料，且需在与用户实时交互、目标欠明确、意图演化的条件下检索知识、发现可用能力并作出合规的状态变更。此外，面向人对话的评测缺少对"效率"（轮数、时延、工具调用量）的度量，而额外轮次会显著拉长解决时间、提高认知负担并损害信任。因此需要一个把"检索—推理—工具—合规状态变更"统一起来、可客观验证的完全智能体化长程基准。
AI.method:
环境被形式化为 Dec-POMDP，共享全局状态 S = S_db × S_history（银行数据库状态 + 完整交互历史）；智能体不可直接观测或修改 S_db，只能通过文档化工具行动并从工具输出与用户话语推断状态，奖励 R: S→[0,1] 由最终数据库状态是否匹配目标决定，因而任务成功可客观验证。
（1）知识库构建（Figure 2 的五阶段流水线）：Stage 1 用 LLM 生成类别→特征→带类型变量（费用、利率、限额等）的结构化规格；Stage 2 将结构化变量按文档标题分配并改写为 FAQ/政策类自然语言文档；Stage 3 人工+LLM 共同构建任务与数据库，并为每个任务标注"金标准文档"集合；Stage 4 迭代修改结构化变量并局部重跑生成管线；Stage 5 由两位未参与创建的审阅者独立审计（终态正确性、gold 文档集完整且最小、仅用 gold 文档与已文档化工具可完成），大规模实验后再次复查轨迹以排除投机捷径。
（2）可发现工具（discoverable tools）：51 个工具仅以函数签名形式在文档中被提及，必须先调用 unlock_discoverable_agent_tool 再以 call_discoverable_agent_tool(name, kwargs) 调用，等价于"以知识状态为条件的动作空间扩展"，使能力获取严格依赖检索成功；另有 14 个常驻工具、若干"用户可发现工具"可委托给用户执行。
（3）用户模拟：基于 flow 的条件规则（依据可观测的智能体动作/环境结果决定用户下一步），未被规则覆盖的部分由 LLM 自由生成以保留语言多样性；用户模拟器统一为 GPT-5.2 低推理档。97 个任务覆盖开户/销户、推荐奖励、争议与额度提升、丢卡补卡等，平均每任务需 18.6 篇 gold 文档、9.52 次工具调用（最多 33 次）。
（4）评测配置：稠密检索（text-embedding-3-large、Qwen3-emb-8b，top-10，工具 KB_search）、稀疏 BM25、终端式检索（知识库导出为沙箱文件、单一 shell 工具，可用 grep/cat/find 自由探索）、golden retriever（直接注入 gold 文档）、no-knowledge 与 long-context 两个消融基线。上下文管理采用轻量截断（超限时按累积检索输出的 1/4 逐出最旧检索结果并留占位符，实际仅 GPT-5.2 高推理在约 1–3% 运行中触发）。
（5）模型与指标：GPT-5.2（高/无推理）、Claude-4.5-Opus、Claude-4.5-Sonnet、Gemini-3-Pro、Gemini-3-Flash；指标为 pass^k（k≤4，全部独立试验均成功的概率）、文档召回率（gold 文档至少一次进入上下文的比例）、以及效率指标（token、检索/shell 调用数、任务时长、轮次时延）。
AI.result: 1) 难度极高：最佳 pass^1 为 25.52%（GPT-5.2 高推理 + 终端），Claude-4.5-Opus 终端 24.74%、Sonnet 终端 22.42%；最佳 pass^4 仅 13.40%（GPT-5.2 高推理 + Qwen3-emb-8b）。2) 检索并非唯一瓶颈：Gold 设置下最高仅 39.69%（Claude-4.5-Opus），其 pass^4 降到 26.80%；各模型平均 Gold 32.18% vs 稠密 16.88/17.11%、BM25 17.04%、终端 19.20%。3) 自由搜索只惠及新推理模型：终端配置平均显著优于稠密/稀疏检索（增益集中在最新的高推理模型；GPT-5.2 无推理及 GPT-4o/4.1 不受益），且文档召回未同步提升，说明收益更多来自策略性推理与解析而非"检索更多"。4) 效率与性能背离：GPT-5.2 高推理 + 终端性能与 Claude-4.5-Opus + 终端相当，但约用 1.7× token、2.3× shell 命令、9× 时长；稠密检索平均搜索 9.9–10.1 次、BM25 11.4 次、终端 grep 14.5 次（终端全部 shell 调用 28.8 次/任务），终端中位轮时比稠密高 6.6 秒，最慢轮 90 分位对 Gemini-3-Flash 慢约 85%。Claude 族 token 更少（0.7M vs 1.2M）、KB_search 更少（8.7 vs 18.5 次/任务）。5) 召回差异大：text-embedding-3-large 配 Opus 召回 57%，配 GPT-5.2（无推理）仅 28%，说明检索质量同时取决于查询生成与迭代方式。6) 消融有效：no-knowledge 平均 pass^1 约 2%（非零来自两个"不幻觉"锚定检查任务）；long-context 注入全部知识库仅约 12%（GPT-5.2 高、Gemini-3-Pro），说明非 gold 文档构成有效噪声，定向检索仍有价值。7) 用户模拟可靠：194 条标注轨迹中仅 4 条含 task-critical 用户错误。8) 失败模式聚类：产品复杂互依约 14.5%、未遵循隐式子任务顺序（争议未结则额度提升被拒）约 5%、过度信任用户陈述约 4%、检索低效与武断假设（欠明确时直接锁定信用卡类别而非澄清）约 23%。
AI.conclusion: τ-Knowledge 通过 τ-Banking 领域提供了一个把"非结构化知识检索—多跳政策推理—可验证状态变更"耦合起来的真实评测床：知识获取与能力发现被设计为状态依赖，知识缺失会直接转化为持久的系统状态差异，从而确保失败反映模型能力而非任务设计缺陷。结果表明前沿模型在知识落地型对话任务上远未可靠（pass^1 ~25%），且失败同时源自"检索不到"与"检索到却用不对"。论文由此主张，面向人类的智能体进展不应只看最终成功率，还应度量"解法效率"——以最少时间、工具调用与对话回退达成正确且合规的结果；并指出未来方向包括更真实的用户模拟（口语化、模糊、专家程度差异）、长程上下文管理（摘要、检索感知压缩、笔记/状态追踪等写工具）、以及受限检索预算下检索配置的决定性作用研究。

title: Q-Measure-Learning for Continuous State RL: Efficient Implementation and Convergence
summary: We study reinforcement learning in infinite-horizon discounted Markov decision processes with continuous state spaces, where data are generated online from a single trajectory under a Markovian behavior policy. To avoid maintaining an infinite-dimensional, function-valued estimate, we propose the novel Q-Measure-Learning, which learns a signed empirical measure supported on visited state-action pairs and reconstructs an action-value estimate via kernel integration. The method jointly estimates the stationary distribution of the behavior chain and the Q-measure through coupled stochastic approximation, leading to an efficient weight-based implementation with $O(n)$ memory and $O(n)$ computation cost per iteration. Under uniform ergodicity of the behavior chain, we prove almost sure sup-norm convergence of the induced Q-function to the fixed point of a kernel-smoothed Bellman operator. We also bound the approximation error between this limit and the optimal $Q^*$ as a function of the kernel bandwidth. To assess the performance of our proposed algorithm, we conduct RL experiments in a two-item inventory control setting.

AI.tldr: 研究无限视界折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的强化学习，状态空间连续，数据由单一轨迹在马尔可夫行为策略下在线生成。提出Q-Measure-Learning方法，通过学习支撑在访问状态-动作对上的符号经验测度，并利用核积分重构动作值估计，避免维护无限维函数值估计。
AI.motivation: 在连续状态空间中，强化学习面临维度诅咒问题，传统的函数逼近方法需要维护无限维函数估计，计算和存储开销巨大。现有方法在处理在线单轨迹数据时效率较低。
AI.method: 提出Q-Measure-Learning方法，通过以下步骤实现：(1)学习支撑在访问状态-动作对上的符号经验测度；(2)通过核积分重构动作值估计；(3)通过耦合随机近似联合估计行为链的平稳分布和Q-测度。算法实现为高效的基于权重的方法，内存复杂度O(n)，每次迭代计算复杂度O(n)。
AI.result: 在行为链均匀遍历性条件下，证明了诱导Q函数几乎处处逐点收敛到核平滑Bellman算子的不动点，并将该极限与最优Q*之间的近似误差作为核带宽的函数进行界估计。在双商品库存控制环境中进行了强化学习实验验证。
AI.conclusion: Q-Measure-Learning方法能够有效处理连续状态空间中的在线强化学习问题，在理论上有收敛保证，在实践中表现良好。

title: Test-Time Meta-Adaptation with Self-Synthesis
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ICLR 2026 LIT and Data-FM Workshops
summary: As strong general reasoners, large language models (LLMs) encounter diverse domains and tasks, where the ability to adapt and self-improve at test time is valuable. We introduce MASS, a meta-learning framework that enables LLMs to self-adapt by generating problem-specific synthetic training data and performing targeted self-updates optimized for downstream performance at inference time. We train this behavior end-to-end via bilevel optimization: an inner loop adapts on self-generated examples while an outer loop meta-learns data-attribution signals and rewards post-update task performance. The synthetic data is optimized with scalable meta-gradients, backpropagating the downstream loss through the inner updates to reward useful generations. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that MASS learns to synthesize per-instance curricula that yield effective, data-efficient test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: MASS是一个元学习框架，使LLMs能够通过生成问题特定合成训练数据并进行针对性自我更新，在推理时实现自适应。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型需要适应多样领域和任务，在测试时具备自适应和自我改进能力具有重要价值；现有方法缺乏有效利用模型自身生成数据进行推理时适应的机制。
AI.method: 提出MASS元学习框架，采用双层优化：内层在自生成示例上进行自适应，外层元学习数据归因信号和更新后任务性能奖励；通过可扩展元梯度优化合成数据，将下游损失反向传播到内层更新以奖励有用的生成。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上的实验表明，MASS学会了合成每实例课程，实现了有效且数据高效的测试时适应。
AI.conclusion: MASS通过元学习框架成功实现了LLMs在推理时的自我适应，通过合成实例特定课程实现高效、数据高效的测试时适应，为大型语言模型的持续学习提供了新范式。

title: Logit-Level Uncertainty Quantification in Vision-Language Models for Histopathology Image Analysis
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with their multimodal capabilities have demonstrated remarkable success in almost all domains, including education, transportation, healthcare, energy, finance, law, and retail. Nevertheless, the utilization of VLMs in healthcare applications raises crucial concerns due to the sensitivity of large-scale medical data and the trustworthiness of these models (reliability, transparency, and security). This study proposes a logit-level uncertainty quantification (UQ) framework for histopathology image analysis using VLMs to deal with these concerns. UQ is evaluated for three VLMs using metrics derived from temperature-controlled output logits. The proposed framework demonstrates a critical separation in uncertainty behavior. While VLMs show high stochastic sensitivity (cosine similarity (CS) $<0.71$ and $<0.84$, Jensen-Shannon divergence (JS) $<0.57$ and $<0.38$, and Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL) $<0.55$ and $<0.35$, respectively for mean values of VILA-M3-8B and LLaVA-Med v1.5), near-maximal temperature impacts ($Δ_T \approx 1.00$), and displaying abrupt uncertainty transitions, particularly for complex diagnostic prompts. In contrast, the pathology-specific PRISM model maintains near-deterministic behavior (mean CS $>0.90$, JS $<0.10$, KL $<0.09$) and significantly minimal temperature effects across all prompt complexities. These findings emphasize the importance of logit-level uncertainty quantification to evaluate trustworthiness in histopathology applications utilizing VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模型无关的“logit 级”不确定性量化（UQ）框架，用于评估三个视觉语言模型（VILA-M3-8B、LLaVA-Med v1.5、病理专用 PRISM）在组织病理图像诊断中的可信度。通过在 11 个温度（0.0–1.0）下对 100 张 ARCH 病理切片、3 类诊断复杂度提示各重复 30 次生成（每模型 99,000 次），直接从输出 logits 计算余弦相似度（CS）、JS/KL 散度与 MAE。结论：通用与生物医学 VLM 在 T→1 时不确定性急剧上升（CS 均值 <0.71/<0.84，Δ_T≈1.00），复杂诊断提示尤其敏感；而病理专用 PRISM 近乎确定性（CS 均值 >0.90，JS<0.10，KL<0.09，Δ_T<0.10），提示领域专化可显著提升可信度。
AI.motivation: 尽管 VLM 在教育、医疗、金融等领域取得成功，但其在高风险医疗场景（尤其是病理诊断）中面临数据敏感性与可信度（可靠性、透明性、安全性）问题。现有文献中针对病理 VLM 的不确定性量化（UQ）研究极为稀缺，且已有工作多集中于 token 级多样性或单一指标（如 conformal prediction、ViLU 框架），难以刻画连续概率空间中的分布性不确定性。作者指出单一指标不足以提供可靠洞见，需结合互补指标（相似度 + 散度 + 幅值误差）才能系统刻画模型行为，并需同时考察全局嵌入空间结构与局部 logit 行为。
AI.method: 框架包含五个环节：(1) 图像嵌入提取——CLIP 视觉编码器（VILA-M3/LLaVA-Med）输出视觉 token 序列，PRISM 使用病理专用 Virchow 编码器并以 [cls token, MeanPool(patch)] 拼接为 2560 维向量；(2) 嵌入空间表征——对 100 张代表性子集的嵌入做 t-SNE 降维可视化，以验证子集覆盖性；(3) 温度控制的自回归解码——h_t = f_θ(y_<t, V, p)、z_t = W_o h_t、P_T = softmax(z_t/T)，T=0 为确定性贪心，T>0 结合 nucleus sampling (p=0.9) 引入可控随机性，并逐步保存完整 logit 序列；(4) logit 张量归一化对齐至最小公共长度 T_min 后，对 N=30 次重复做全部 C(30,2)=435 组两两比较，计算 CS、KL、JS、MAE 四项指标；(5) 归一化到 [0,1] 并跨模型可比，同时统计全温度区间的均值 μ、标准差与温度效应 Δ_T=|M(T=1)−M(T=0)|。实验设计：ARCH 数据集 100 张 patch、3 个提示复杂度层级（基础形态学 / 中等分级诊断 / 高级定量分析）、11 个温度、每配置 30 次重复；VILA-M3 与 LLaVA-Med 启用 KV-cache 将复杂度从 O(T²) 降至 O(T)，PRISM 因无 KV-cache 且具确定性解码，需借助高斯噪声注入与 dropout 扰动。
AI.result: CS 分析：VILA-M3 在 T≤0.3 时 CS>0.9，随后单调降至 T=1.0 时 0.35–0.56；LLaVA-Med Q1 由 1.0 降至 0.04，Q3 降至约 0.02；PRISM 在 T≤0.7 及全温度区间均保持 >0.9。散度分析：VILA-M3 的 JS 在 T=1.0 达 0.95–1.0、KL 达 0.8–1.0；LLaVA-Med Q2/Q3 在 T≈0.4–0.7 出现不确定性突变，Q1 全程 JS<0.2；PRISM 在 T≤0.7 时 JS/KL<0.1。MAE：三模型均随温度单调增长，Q2/Q3 在 T≥0.8 时所有模型–提示组合收敛，提示高温度掩盖了模型与提示差异。汇总：VILA-M3 平均 CS 为 0.397–0.712、Δ_T∈[0.624,0.707]，Q3 平均 JS 达 0.572；LLaVA-Med Q1 稳健（JS 均值 0.018）而 Q2/Q3 的 Δ_T 接近 1.0，Q2 的平均 JS（0.321）为 Q1 的 17.8 倍；PRISM 平均 CS>0.90、Δ_T<0.10，JS/KL 均值仅 0.08–0.10，但其 MAE 的 Δ_T 仍达 0.78–0.91，说明分布稳定而 logit 绝对幅值仍在波动。指标相关性：CS 与 JS/KL/MAE 分别呈强负相关（−0.924/−0.918/−0.963），JS 与 KL 近乎完全相关（0.997），全部 p<0.001，说明 CS+JS 的子集即可支撑 UQ。推荐工作点：LLaVA-Med Q1 用 T≤0.5（CS>0.90、JS<0.05），Q2/Q3 用 T≤0.3；VILA-M3 全部提示用 T≤0.4，T=0.3 为一致性–多样性最佳折中；PRISM 因温度不敏感需改用数据丢失/高斯噪声注入等替代扰动。
AI.conclusion: logit 级 UQ 揭示了 VLM 在组织病理应用中的可信度高度依赖模型领域专化程度、提示复杂度与温度设置。通用/生物医学 VLM 仅在基础形态学任务上相对稳定，对中级分级与高级定量诊断提示则表现出显著随机扰动与突变式不确定性；病理专用 PRISM 因架构确定性而近乎无随机性、温度不敏感，兼具高一致性与低分布不确定性，但绝对 logit 幅值仍随温度变化，且其确定性机制反而限制了标准温度式 UQ 手段的适用性。作者强调单一 token 级指标不足，需将互补的相似度与散度指标联合使用，并对高不确定性输出应交由专科医师审慎解读，从而构建面向临床的可信、不确定性感知的人机协同系统。

title: mlx-snn: Spiking Neural Networks on Apple Silicon via MLX
summary: We introduce mlx-snn, the first spiking neural network (SNN) library built natively on Apple's MLX framework. As SNN research grows rapidly, all major libraries -- snnTorch, Norse, SpikingJelly, Lava -- target PyTorch or custom backends, leaving Apple Silicon users without a native option. mlx-snn provides six neuron models (LIF, IF, Izhikevich, Adaptive LIF, Synaptic, Alpha), four surrogate gradient functions, four spike encoding methods (including an EEG-specific encoder), and a complete backpropagation-through-time training pipeline. The library leverages MLX's unified memory architecture, lazy evaluation, and composable function transforms (mx.grad, mx.compile) to enable efficient SNN research on Apple Silicon hardware. We validate mlx-snn on MNIST digit classification across five hyperparameter configurations and three backends, achieving up to 97.28% accuracy with 2.0--2.5 times faster training and 3--10 times lower GPU memory than snnTorch on the same M3 Max hardware. mlx-snn is open-source under the MIT license and available on PyPI. https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/mlx-snn

AI.tldr: mlx-snn是首个基于Apple MLX框架构建的原生SNN库，为Apple Silicon用户提供专用工具，包含6种神经元模型、4种替代梯度函数和4种脉冲编码方法，在MNIST上实现97.28%准确率，训练速度和内存效率均显著优于snnTorch。
AI.motivation: 随着SNN研究快速发展，现有的主流SNN库（snnTorch、Norse、SpikingJelly、Lava）均基于PyTorch或自定义后端开发，导致Apple Silicon用户缺乏原生支持的SNN研究工具。
AI.method: mlx-snn构建于Apple MLX框架之上，充分利用其统一内存架构、惰性求值和可组合函数变换（mx.grad、mx.compile）。库包含六种神经元模型（LIF、IF、Izhikevich、Adaptive LIF、Synaptic、Alpha）、四种替代梯度函数、四种脉冲编码方法（含EEG专用编码器），以及完整的BPTT训练流程。
AI.result: 在MNIST手写数字分类任务上，使用五种超参数配置进行验证，mlx-snn在M3 Max硬件上达到最高97.28%的准确率，训练速度比snnTorch快2.0-2.5倍，GPU内存占用低3-10倍。
AI.conclusion: mlx-snn是首个原生支持Apple Silicon的SNN库，基于MIT许可证开源，可通过PyPI安装。该库填补了Apple Silicon平台上缺乏专业SNN研究工具的空白，为M3 Max硬件上的SNN研究提供了高效、实用的解决方案。

title: Directional Neural Collapse Explains Few-Shot Transfer in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Frozen self-supervised representations often transfer well with only a few labels across many semantic tasks. We argue that a single geometric quantity, \emph{directional} CDNV (decision-axis variance), sits at the core of two favorable behaviors: strong few-shot transfer within a task, and low interference across many tasks. We show that both emerge when variability \emph{along} class-separating directions is small. First, we prove sharp non-asymptotic multiclass generalization bounds for downstream classification whose leading term is the directional CDNV. The bounds include finite-shot corrections that cleanly separate intrinsic decision-axis variability from centroid-estimation error. Second, we link decision-axis collapse to multitask geometry: for independent balanced labelings, small directional CDNV across tasks forces the corresponding decision axes to be nearly orthogonal, helping a single representation support many tasks with minimal interference. Empirically, across SSL objectives, directional CDNV collapses during pretraining even when classical CDNV remains large, and our bounds closely track few-shot error at practical shot sizes. Additionally, on synthetic multitask data, we verify that SSL learns representations whose induced decision axes are nearly orthogonal. The code and project page of the paper are available at [\href{https://dlfundamentals.github.io/directional-neural-collapse/}{project page}].

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自监督学习中方向性CDNV（决策轴方差）的几何特性，证明它是理解少样本迁移能力和多任务低干扰的关键指标。作者建立了非渐近泛化边界，将小方向性CDNV与决策轴近似正交联系起来，并通过实验验证了方向性CDNV在预训练中的崩溃现象以及其对少样本误差的追踪能力。
AI.motivation: 冻络自监督表示在仅需少量标签的情况下就能在许多语义任务中良好迁移，但这一现象的几何解释尚不明确。作者认为方向性CDNV（决策轴方差）是两种有利行为的核心：强少样本任务内迁移和多任务低干扰。
AI.method: 1. 证明了尖锐的非渐近多类泛化边界，领先项为方向性CDNV，包含有限样本校正，明确分离了内在决策轴变异性与质心估计误差；2. 将决策轴崩溃与多任务几何联系起来，证明对于独立平衡标签，小方向性CDNV强制决策轴近似正交；3. 在SSL目标上进行了实证验证，并在合成多任务数据上验证了SSL学习到的表示的决策轴近似正交。
AI.result: 1. 方向性CDNV在预训练期间会崩溃，即使经典CDNV仍然很大；2. 边界紧密跟踪实际少样本大小下的少样本误差；3. 在合成多任务数据上验证了SSL学习到的表示的决策轴近似正交。
AI.conclusion: directional CDNV 是一个关键的几何指标，能够解释自监督学习中两个重要的特性：少样本迁移能力和多任务低干扰。该研究建立了理论保证，并验证了方向性CDNV在预训练过程中确实会崩溃，而经典CDNV却保持较大值，这表明方向性CDNV是更敏感的指标。

title: Role-Aware Conditional Inference for Spatiotemporal Ecosystem Carbon Flux Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of terrestrial ecosystem carbon fluxes (e.g., CO$_2$, GPP, and CH$_4$) is essential for understanding the global carbon cycle and managing its impacts. However, prediction remains challenging due to strong spatiotemporal heterogeneity: ecosystem flux responses are constrained by slowly varying regime conditions, while short-term fluctuations are driven by high-frequency dynamic forcings. Most existing learning-based approaches treat environmental covariates as a homogeneous input space, implicitly assuming a global response function, which leads to brittle generalization across heterogeneous ecosystems. In this work, we propose Role-Aware Conditional Inference (RACI), a process-informed learning framework that formulates ecosystem flux prediction as a conditional inference problem. RACI employs hierarchical temporal encoding to disentangle slow regime conditioners from fast dynamic drivers, and incorporates role-aware spatial retrieval that supplies functionally similar and geographically local context for each role. By explicitly modeling these distinct functional roles, RACI enables a model to adapt its predictions across diverse environmental regimes without training separate local models or relying on fixed spatial structures. We evaluate RACI across multiple ecosystem types (wetlands and agricultural systems), carbon fluxes (CO$_2$, GPP, CH$_4$), and data sources, including both process-based simulations and observational measurements. Across all settings, RACI consistently outperforms competitive spatiotemporal baselines, demonstrating improved accuracy and spatial generalization under pronounced environmental heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: RACI是一种过程知情的学习框架，通过层次化时间编码和角色感知空间检索来分别处理慢速regime条件和快速动态驱动，解决陆地生态系统碳通量预测中的时空异质性问题，在多种生态系统和碳通量上优于现有时空基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有学习方法将环境协变量视为同质输入空间，隐含假设全局响应函数，导致在异质生态系统间的泛化能力较差。生态系统通量响应受慢变 regime 条件约束，而短期波动由高频动态驱动，这种时空异质性使得准确预测具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出角色感知条件推理（RACI）框架，将生态系统通量预测建模为条件推理问题。采用层次化时间编码 disentangle 慢速 regime 条件器和快速动态驱动，并引入角色感知空间检索，为每个角色提供功能相似且地理局部化的上下文信息。
AI.result: RACI在多种生态系统类型（湿地和农业系统）、碳通量（CO2、GPP、CH4）和数据源（过程模拟和观测测量）上评估，均一致优于具有竞争力的时空基线方法，展示了在显著环境异质性下的更高准确性和空间泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RACI通过显式建模慢速 regime 条件和快速动态驱动的不同功能角色，使模型能够适应不同的环境异质性，而无需训练单独的局部模型或依赖固定的空间结构。该框架在多种生态系统类型和碳通量上均展现出优越的预测准确性和空间泛化能力。

title: Trade-offs in Ensembling, Merging and Routing Among Parameter-Efficient Experts
summary: While large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with lightweight adapters achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, their performance on individual tasks depends on the fine-tuning strategy. Fusing independently trained models with different strengths has shown promise for multi-task learning through three main strategies: ensembling, which combines outputs from independent models; merging, which fuses model weights via parameter averaging; and routing, which integrates models in an input-dependent fashion. However, many design decisions in these approaches remain understudied, and the relative benefits of more sophisticated ensembling, merging and routing techniques are not fully understood. We empirically evaluate their trade-offs, addressing two key questions: What are the advantages of going beyond uniform ensembling or merging? And does the flexibility of routing justify its complexity? Our findings indicate that non-uniform ensembling and merging improve performance, but routing offers even greater gains. To mitigate the computational cost of routing, we analyze expert selection techniques, showing that clustering and greedy subset selection can maintain reasonable performance with minimal overhead. These insights advance our understanding of model fusion for multi-task learning.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了大型语言模型(LLM)在多任务学习中三种模型融合策略(集成、合并、路由)的权衡问题，发现非均匀方法优于均匀方法，路由灵活性带来最大收益，但可通过聚类或贪心子集选择降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 当前研究对模型融合的设计决策缺乏充分研究，不同融合策略(集成、合并、路由)的相对优势尚未被系统理解，需要实证评估这些方法在多任务学习中的权衡取舍。
AI.method: 作者通过实证评估三种融合策略：(1)集成(ensemble)组合独立模型输出；(2)合并(merging)通过参数平均融合模型权重；(3)路由(routing)以输入依赖方式集成模型。同时分析了专家选择技术(聚类、贪心子集选择)以降低路由计算成本。
AI.result: 研究发现：非均匀集成和合并优于均匀方法；路由灵活性带来更大性能提升；聚类和贪心子集选择可在最小开销下维持合理性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究深化了对多任务学习模型融合的理解，为实践者选择融合策略提供了实证依据：路由虽计算成本高但性能最优，可通过专家选择技术缓解其计算开销。

title: Online Learnability of Chain-of-Thought Verifiers: Soundness and Completeness Trade-offs
summary: Large language models with chain-of-thought generation have demonstrated great potential for producing complex mathematical proofs. However, their reasoning can often go astray, leading to increasing interest in formal and learned verifiers. A major challenge in learning verifiers, especially when their output will be used by the prover, is that this feedback loop may produce substantial distribution shift. Motivated by this challenge, we propose an online learning framework for learning chain-of-thought verifiers that, given a problem and a sequence of reasoning steps, check the correctness of the solution. Highlighting the asymmetric role of soundness (failure in catching errors in a proof) and completeness (flagging correct proofs as wrong) mistakes of the verifier, we introduce novel extensions of the Littlestone dimension which tightly characterize the mistake bounds for learning a verifier in the realizable setting. We provide optimal algorithms for finding the Pareto-frontier (the smallest total number of mistakes given a budget of soundness mistakes) as well as minimizing a linear combination of asymmetric costs. We further show how our learned verifiers can be used to boost the accuracy of a collection of weak provers, and enable generation of proofs beyond what they were trained on. With the mild assumption that one of the provers can generate the next reasoning step correctly with some minimal probability, we show how to learn a strong prover with small error and abstention rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在线学习框架，用于学习链式思考(CoT)验证器，以检查数学推理的正确性。通过引入Littlestone维度的新扩展，刻画了可实现设定下验证器的错误边界，并提供了寻找Pareto前沿的最优算法。验证器可提升弱证明器的准确率，在某些假设下能学习到强证明器。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生成长链式推理时容易出错，现有验证器面临反馈循环带来的分布偏移挑战。验证器的soundness（漏检错误）和completeness（误报正确证明）具有不对称性，需要专门的学习框架。
AI.method: 提出在线学习框架学习CoT验证器；引入Littlestone维度的novel扩展来刻画错误边界；提供寻找Pareto前沿的最优算法（最小化总错误数给定soundness错误预算）；最小化非对称成本的线性组合。
AI.result: 理论结果：刻画了可实现设定下的最优错误边界；算法能找到soundness-completeness的Pareto最优解。应用结果：验证器可提升弱证明器的准确性，在假设某个证明器能以最小概率正确生成下一步推理时，可学习到强证明器且具有小的错误率和放弃率。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线学习框架和Littlestone维度理论，为学习CoT验证器提供了坚实的理论基础，解决了分布偏移问题，实现了弱证明器的增强，为构建可靠的数学推理系统提供了新方法。

title: Transport Clustering: Solving Low-Rank Optimal Transport via Clustering
summary: Optimal transport (OT) finds a least cost transport plan between two probability distributions using a cost matrix defined on pairs of points. Unlike standard OT, which infers unstructured pointwise mappings, low-rank optimal transport explicitly constrains the rank of the transport plan to infer latent structure. This improves statistical stability and robustness, yields sharper parametric rates for estimating Wasserstein distances adaptive to the intrinsic rank, and generalizes $K$-means to co-clustering. These advantages, however, come at the cost of a non-convex and NP-hard optimization problem. We introduce transport clustering, an algorithm to compute a low-rank OT plan that reduces low-rank OT to a clustering problem on correspondences obtained from a full-rank $\textit{transport registration}$ step. We prove that this reduction yields polynomial-time, constant-factor approximation algorithms for low-rank OT: specifically, a $(1+γ)$ approximation for negative-type metrics and a $(1+γ+\sqrt{2γ}\,)$ approximation for kernel costs, where $γ\in [0,1]$ denotes the approximation ratio of the optimal full-rank solution relative to the low-rank optimal. Empirically, transport clustering outperforms existing low-rank OT solvers on synthetic benchmarks and large-scale, high-dimensional datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transport Clustering算法，将低秩最优运输问题约简为聚类问题，在全秩运输配准步骤得到的对应关系上进行聚类。该方法在负-type度量上达到(1+γ)近似，在核函数成本上达到(1+γ+√(2γ))近似，且在合成数据和大规模高维数据集上表现优于现有低秩OT求解器。
AI.motivation: 标准最优运输(OT)在两点定义成本矩阵寻找最小成本运输计划，但低秩OT显式约束运输计划秩以推断潜在结构，可提高统计稳定性、获得更Sharp的Wasserstein距离参数估计率，并将K-means推广到协同聚类。然而这些优势伴随非凸且NP-hard的优化问题。
AI.method: 提出Transport Clustering算法，将低秩OT约简为在全秩transport registration步骤获得的对应关系上进行聚类的问题。
AI.result: 证明该约简可产生多项式时间常数因子近似算法：负型度量(negative-type metrics)达到(1+γ)近似，核函数成本(kernel costs)达到(1+γ+√(2γ))近似，其中γ∈[0,1]表示相对于低秩最优的全秩解的近似比。实验表明transport clustering在合成基准测试和大规模高维数据集上优于现有低秩OT求解器。
AI.conclusion: 成功将低秩OT这一NP-hard问题约简为多项式时间可解的聚类问题，并给出了常数因子近似保证，为低秩结构推断提供了有效的计算框架。

title: Hybrid Belief Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coordinated Spatial Exploration
summary: Coordinating multiple autonomous agents to explore and serve spatially heterogeneous demand requires jointly learning unknown spatial patterns and planning trajectories that maximize task performance. Pure model-based approaches provide structured uncertainty estimates but lack adaptive policy learning, while deep reinforcement learning often suffers from poor sample efficiency when spatial priors are absent. This paper presents a hybrid belief-reinforcement learning (HBRL) framework to address this gap. In the first phase, agents construct spatial beliefs using a Log-Gaussian Cox Process (LGCP) and execute information-driven trajectories guided by a Pathwise Mutual Information (PathMI) planner with multi-step lookahead. In the second phase, trajectory control is transferred to a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent, warm-started through dual-channel knowledge transfer: belief state initialization supplies spatial uncertainty, and replay buffer seeding provides demonstration trajectories generated during LGCP exploration. A variance-normalized overlap penalty enables coordinated coverage through shared belief state, permitting cooperative sensing in high-uncertainty regions while discouraging redundant coverage in well-explored areas. The framework is evaluated on a multi-UAV wireless service provisioning task. Results show 10.8% higher cumulative reward and 38% faster convergence over baselines, with ablation studies confirming that dual-channel transfer outperforms either channel alone.

AI.tldr: 提出混合信念-强化学习(HBRL)框架，通过LGCP+PathMI进行空间信念构建和信息驱动探索，然后利用双通道知识迁移(信念状态初始化+回放缓冲区填充)warm-start SAC智能体，实现多智能体协同覆盖优化。在多UAV无线服务任务中提升10.8%累积奖励和38%收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 协调多个自主智能体探索和服务空间异构需求，需要同时学习未知空间模式和规划最大化任务性能的轨迹。纯模型方法提供结构化不确定性估计但缺乏自适应策略学习，而深度强化学习在缺乏空间先验时往往样本效率较差。
AI.method: 提出混合信念-强化学习(HBRL)框架，包含两阶段：第一阶段使用Log-Gaussian Cox Process(LGCP)构建空间信念，采用Pathwise Mutual Information(PathMI)Planner进行信息驱动的轨迹规划；第二阶段将控制权转移给Soft Actor-Critic(SAC)智能体，通过双通道知识迁移进行warm-start：信念状态初始化提供空间不确定性，回放缓冲区填充提供LGCP探索期间生成的演示轨迹。采用方差归一化重叠惩罚实现协同覆盖。
AI.result: 在多UAV无线服务供给任务中，相较于baseline，HBRL实现10.8%更高的累积奖励和38%更快的收敛速度。消融实验证实双通道迁移优于任一单一通道。
AI.conclusion: HBRL框架通过双通道知识迁移有效解决了多智能体协同探索中的样本效率问题，dual-channel transfer比单一通道表现更优。该研究为模型-based与深度强化学习的混合方法提供了新的思路。

title: NuMuon: Nuclear-Norm-Constrained Muon for Compressible LLM Training
summary: The rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly constrained by memory and deployment costs, motivating compression methods for practical deployment. Many state-of-the-art compression pipelines leverage the low-rank structure of trained weight matrices, a phenomenon often associated with the properties of popular optimizers such as Adam. In this context, Muon is a recently proposed optimizer that improves LLM pretraining via full-rank update steps, but its induced weight-space structure has not been characterized yet. In this work, we report a surprising empirical finding: despite imposing full-rank updates, Muon-trained models exhibit pronounced low-rank structure in their weight matrices and are readily compressible under standard pipelines. Motivated by this insight, we propose NuMuon, which augments Muon with a nuclear-norm constraint on the update direction, further constraining the learned weights toward low-rank structure. Across billion-parameter-scale models, we show that NuMuon increases weight compressibility and improves post-compression model quality under state-of-the-art LLM compression pipelines while retaining Muon's favorable convergence behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文发现尽管Muon优化器采用全秩更新，但其训练的模型仍表现出显著的低秩结构，可被标准压缩pipeline压缩。基于这一发现，提出NuMuon优化器，通过在Muon上加入核范数约束来进一步约束权重向低秩结构学习。实验表明NuMuon在十亿参数规模模型上增强了权重可压缩性并改善了压缩后的模型质量。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的快速发展受到内存和部署成本的限制，推动了模型压缩方法的需求。许多先进的压缩pipeline利用训练权重矩阵的低秩结构，这与Adam等流行优化器的特性相关。Muon优化器通过全秩更新步骤改进LLM预训练，但其诱导的权重空间结构尚未被表征。
AI.method: 提出NuMuon优化器，在Muon基础上引入核范数约束来约束更新方向，从而将学习权重进一步推向低秩结构。具体而言，对更新方向施加核范数正则化，以促进权重矩阵的低秩特性。
AI.result: 在十亿参数规模的模型上，NuMuon提高了权重可压缩性，在保持Muon良好收敛行为的同时，提升了模型在先进LLM压缩pipeline下的压缩后质量。
AI.conclusion: NuMuon成功结合了全秩更新（来自Muon）的优势与通过低秩结构增强的可压缩性，为实际LLM部署提供了有前景的方法。实验表明，NuMuon在十亿参数规模模型上显著提高了权重可压缩性，并在保持Muon良好收敛行为的同时，改善了压缩后的模型质量。

title: Riemannian Optimization in Modular Systems
summary:
Understanding how systems built out of modular components can be jointly optimized is an important problem in biology, engineering, and machine learning. The backpropagation algorithm is one such solution and has been instrumental in the success of neural networks. Despite its empirical success, a strong theoretical understanding of it is lacking. Here, we combine tools from Riemannian geometry, optimal control theory, and theoretical physics to advance this understanding.
  We make three key contributions: First, we revisit the derivation of backpropagation as a constrained optimization problem and combine it with the insight that Riemannian gradient descent trajectories can be understood as the minimum of an action. Second, we introduce a recursively defined layerwise Riemannian metric that exploits the modular structure of neural networks and can be efficiently computed using the Woodbury matrix identity, avoiding the $O(n^3)$ cost of full metric inversion. Third, we develop a framework of composable ``Riemannian modules'' whose convergence properties can be quantified using nonlinear contraction theory, providing algorithmic stability guarantees of order $O(κ^2 L/(ξμ\sqrt{n}))$ where $κ$ and $L$ are Lipschitz constants, $μ$ is the mass matrix scale, and $ξ$ bounds the condition number.
  Our layerwise metric approach provides a practical alternative to natural gradient descent. While we focus here on studying neural networks, our approach more generally applies to the study of systems made of modules that are optimized over time, as it occurs in biology during both evolution and development.

AI.tldr: 本文将反向传播重新推导为黎曼流形上受约束优化的作用量（action）驻点问题，引入由网络结构递归诱导的逐层（layerwise）黎曼度量，并借助 Woodbury 恒等式把度量求逆从 O(n³) 降至 O(n·d²+d³)；同时提出可组合的"黎曼模块"框架，用非线性收缩理论给出 O(κ²L/(ξμ√n)) 级别的算法稳定性保证，为自然梯度提供了一种实用替代方案。
AI.motivation: 模块化系统（生物体、工程系统、神经网络）由可各自独立优化的组件构成，其交互需被联合优化。反向传播虽是这一问题的成功范例，但其理论基础仍不完善：缺乏对"梯度下降轨迹到底是什么"的几何/变分解释；自然梯度（Fisher 度量）虽能刻画参数空间几何，但需计算 O(p²) 的 Fisher 矩阵，代价高且不体现模块结构。因此作者希望：(1) 用黎曼几何 + 最优控制 + 理论物理统一解释反向传播；(2) 构造与网络分层结构相匹配、可高效计算的度量；(3) 给出可量化的收敛/稳定性理论，并将其推广到随时间被优化的通用模块系统（如生物的发育与演化）。
AI.method:
**1) 作用量原理（梯度下降的变分解释）**：在黎曼流形 (M,g) 上定义作用量 S = ½∫ds(g_IJ φ̇^I φ̇^J + η²g^IJ ∂_I h ∂_J h)，通过配方与分部积分得 S ≥ η|h(+∞)−h(−∞)|，等号成立当且仅当 dφ^I/ds ± η g^IJ ∂_J h = 0，即黎曼梯度上升/下降。定理1 证明沿该路径哈密顿量 H = ½g^IJ(p_I−η∂_I h)(p_J+η∂_J h) 恒为零（受 Witten 1982 欧氏超对称 σ 模型启发）；定理2 给出哈密顿/测地流方程（η→0 时退化为共测地流与测地流）。对神经网络，引入 Lecun(1988) 式显式约束与 Lagrange 乘子 λ_α，把 ∂h/∂φ^I 表示为各层雅可比与乘子的内积（激活空间余切向量到权重空间的拉回），代入作用量即得梯度下降更新作为作用量驻点。文中还给出 Brayton–Moser 方程与微分代数方程的推广评注。

**2) 逐层黎曼度量与黎曼模块**：定义"拉回度量" f*g_N；将参数按层分块，g = ⊕_α g^(α)，每层度量 G^(α) = J^(α)ᵀ M J^(α) + D^(α)（J 为输出对层参数的雅可比，M 为输出空间正定度量，D 为层特定对角参数度量）。利用 M = LᵀL 的 Cholesky 分解，G^(α) = L^(α)ᵀL^(α) + D^(α)，故只需递归追踪一个 Cholesky 因子。定义"黎曼模块"（输入流形 I、参数流形 W 及其度量 g_W、输出流形 O 及其度量 g_O、光滑映射 f）及其顺序组合（f₂*g_{O₂} = g_{O₁}）与并行组合（笛卡尔积），并给出线性层与逐点非线性激活两个例子。

**3) 高效求逆**：由 D 为对角的前提，对 D + JᵀL_oᵀL_o J 应用 Woodbury 恒等式，得 M^(α)⁻¹ 表达式；只需与向量右乘即可，无需物化 n_α×n_α 逆矩阵，且所有显式求逆被限制在输出维度 n_o×n_o。算法1（Riemannian SGD with Layerwise Metrics）：前向传播 → Cholesky 分解 → 逐层从 L 到 1 计算 J^(α)、标准梯度 g^(α)=J^(α)ᵀ∂ℓ/∂y、预条件梯度 A^(α)、缩放雅可比 K^(α)=L_o J^(α)、内矩阵 S^(α)=I+K D⁻¹Kᵀ（n_o×n_o）、求解 v^(α)=S⁻¹KA、更新 Δw^(α) = −η(A^(α) − D⁻¹K^(α)ᵀv^(α))。

**4) 非线性收缩分析**：扩展 Kozachkov et al. (2023) 第4.3节，比较数据集 S 与替换单个样本 k 的 S′ 的训练动力学；定义广义 NTK 矩阵 H = (1/n)∇_θᵀ ȳ G⁻¹ ∇_θ ȳ ⪰ ξI（依赖 G 正定与雅可比满列秩），扰动项 d_i(t) 上界为 2κ²L/(nμ)（其中 ‖G⁻¹‖₂ ≤ 1/μ 因 G = D + JᵀM_oJ 且 D 最小特征值为 μ），堆叠扰动 ‖d̄‖₂ ≤ 2κ²L/(√n μ)。
AI.result: **定理1/2**：作用量下界仅在黎曼梯度路径上取等；哈密顿量沿梯度上升/下降路径恒为零；给出完整哈密顿方程并在 η→0 时得测地流极限。**定理3（算法稳定性）**：采用正则化拉回度量下的梯度流与均方损失，黎曼模块 F_θ 的算法稳定性率为 ε_stab ~ O(κ²L/(ξ√n μ))，其中 L 为损失的 Lipschitz 常数、μ 为对角度质量矩阵 D 的最小特征值、ξ 为广义 NTK 的下界（即 H ⪰ ξI），证明给出扰动界与最终 ‖y_i − y′_i‖ 的显式上界 2κ²L/(ξ√n μ)，在速率 ξ 的指数暂态后成立。**复杂度**：朴素逐层度量求逆为 O(n³)/层，Woodbury 方案降至 O(n·d² + d³)/层（d = 输出维度），度量存储由 O(n²) 降至 O(n·d)；总代价 O(Σ_α n_α d²) 对比 O(Σ_α n_α³)。当 d ≪ n（如 CIFAR-10 d=10、ImageNet d=1000）时节省显著；所有显式矩阵求逆均限制在 n_o×n_o 维度。
AI.conclusion:
**结论与定位**：本文通过将反向传播置于黎曼流形作用量的驻点框架中重新推导，以变分原理为梯度下降提供了物理层面的严格解释；提出的递归逐层黎曼度量与"黎曼模块"框架，把模块结构内生地嵌入优化几何：度量逐层计算、可用 Woodbury 高效求逆，无需全局 Fisher 矩阵，提供了自然梯度的一种实用替代，并借非线性收缩理论给出可量化的稳定性保证。该框架不仅适用于神经网络，也适用于生物发育/演化、工程模块化系统等"随时间被优化的模块系统"。

**局限（作者自述）**：(1) 相比标准 SGD 仍有额外开销——需计算并存储各层雅可比 J^(α)、维护输出度量的 Cholesky 因子、求解内层线性系统，当输出维度 d 与参数规模 n_α 相比不够小时代价可能不可接受；(2) 输出空间度量 M(y) 的选择依赖问题（已尝试单位阵与 Hessian 型，但 Gauss–Newton 近似未必捕获完整曲率信息），需领域知识与调参；(3) 理论范围受限——推导限于向量空间激活的网络，推广到流形（如图结构）需进一步工作，且收缩分析假设（Lipschitz 连续、雅可比满列秩）未必在整个训练过程中成立；(4) 实证验证有限，仅在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 的图像分类上实验，能否推广到 NLP、强化学习、生成模型等任务或到度量归纳偏置作用不大的场景仍待验证；(5) 引入 D^(α) 对角质量值、正则化参数等额外超参数，其与学习率、批量大小等常规超参的交互敏感性需进一步研究。

title: Why Are Linear RNNs More Parallelizable?
summary: The community is increasingly exploring linear RNNs (LRNNs) as language models, motivated by their expressive power and parallelizability. While prior work establishes the expressivity benefits of LRNNs over transformers, it is unclear what makes LRNNs -- but not traditional, nonlinear RNNs -- as easy to parallelize in practice as transformers. We answer this question by providing a tight connection between types of RNNs and standard complexity classes. We show that LRNNs can be viewed as log-depth (bounded fan-in) arithmetic circuits, which represents only a slight depth overhead relative to log-depth boolean circuits that transformers admit. Furthermore, we show that nonlinear RNNs can solve $\mathsf{L}$-complete problems (and even $\mathsf{P}$-complete ones, under polynomial precision), revealing a fundamental barrier to parallelizing them as efficiently as transformers. Our theory also identifies fine-grained expressivity differences between recent popular LRNN variants: permutation-diagonal LRNNs are $\mathsf{NC}^1$-complete whereas diagonal-plus-low-rank LRNNs are more expressive ($\mathsf{PNC}^1$-complete). We provide further insight by associating each type of RNN with a corresponding automata-theoretic model that it can simulate. Together, our results reveal fundamental tradeoffs between nonlinear RNNs and different variants of LRNNs, providing a foundation for designing LLM architectures that achieve an optimal balance between expressivity and parallelism.
